zh_abstract: 【背景】肝硬化中肝细胞癌（HCC）的短期预测因肝病死亡的竞争风险而变得复杂。我们旨在基于区域范围的常规数据开发一个可解释模型，在预测HCC的同时区分竞争性死亡，并将其与既有风险评分进行比较。【方法】从安达卢西亚人群健康数据库（Andalusian Population Health Database）中区域范围的肝硬化成人队列中，我们在17,177例患者上训练模型，预测日期设定在其结局前12个月，时间为2020年至2023年。基于该日期前一年的电子健康记录（人口学信息、肝脏和慢性病代码以及八项常规实验室检查），一个不含交互项的可解释增强机（Explainable Boosting Machine）将随后12个月分类为HCC、无HCC的死亡或肝移植、或无事件。我们在20次重复的5折交叉验证中评估它，并与二分类模型、含成对交互项的模型以及使用完整健康记录的模型进行比较，所有模型均在相同折上。随后，我们在首次可计算aMAP或Toronto HCC风险指数（Toronto HCC Risk Index）的常规就诊时应用这些交叉验证模型而不再训练，并在竞争风险下对患者进行前瞻随访，将其与这些评分比较，分别在有和无6个月洗脱期的情况下，以及依次将每个省排除于训练之外的情况下进行。 【结果】771例患者（4.5%）在12个月内发生HCC，3,314例（19.3%）无HCC死亡或接受肝移植（3,061例死亡，253例移植）。在交叉验证中，HCC的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.734（SD 0.018）。二分类表述、成对交互和完整健康记录（超过3,000个特征）未改善该模型；完整记录使其降低0.024。在常规就诊时，该模型对12个月HCC的区分优于aMAP（时间依赖性AUC 0.790 vs 0.688；差值+0.102，95% CI +0.071至+0.132）和Toronto HCC风险指数（0.761 vs 0.703；+0.057，+0.032至+0.081），并且在排除6个月内诊断的HCC后（一致性差值+0.055和+0.040）以及依次将八个省中每个省排除于训练之外时仍更优。在组大小相等时，其高风险组所含HCC与这些评分的高风险类别一样多，而竞争性死亡少20-28%。其形状函数将癌症特异性信号（AFP从2升至20 g/L，血小板低于150 x10^9/L）与肝衰竭（胆红素高于51 mol/L，白蛋白

title: deeprok: highly accurate prokaryotic gene prediction through deep learning and overlap-aware decoding
zh_title: deeprok：深度学习提升原核生物基因预测
summary: 预印本发布deeprok，结合碱基级神经网络与重叠感知解码器，改善原核基因及翻译起始位点预测。
key_points: 四个远缘基因组精确匹配错误比Prodigal等少10–18%
2,925个实验验证起始位点错误减少21–41%
碱基级架构揭示谱系特异性翻译起始信号
reason: 预印本方法在远缘基因组和实验验证起点上对比充分，属值得一看偏上档
abstract: Prokaryotic gene prediction is often considered solved, yet widely used tools still disagree on many genes, chiefly short genes and translation starts. We present deeprok, an ab initio prokaryotic gene prediction method that combines a base-level neural network with an overlap-aware decoder, and refines start-site predictions with a self-trained neural ranker. On four curated genomes distant from its training data, deeprok made 10-18% fewer exact-match errors than Prodigal and GeneMarkS-2, and on 2,925 experimentally verified starts it made 21-41% fewer start errors. Furthermore, deeprok's base-level architecture reveals lineage-specific translation initiation signals. These results show that per-base deep learning combined with overlap-aware decoding can improve prokaryotic gene prediction, especially for resolving translation starts.
zh_abstract: 原核基因预测常被认为已解决，然而广泛使用的工具仍在许多基因上不一致，主要是短基因和翻译起始。我们提出deeprok，一种从头原核基因预测方法，它结合碱基级神经网络与重叠感知解码器，并用自训练神经排序器细化起始位点预测。在四个与其训练数据相距较远的精选基因组上，deeprok的精确匹配错误比Prodigal和GeneMarkS-2少10-18%，在2,925个实验验证的起始位点上，其起始错误少21-41%。此外，deeprok的碱基级架构揭示了谱系特异性翻译起始信号。这些结果表明，逐碱基深度学习结合重叠感知解码可改善原核基因预测，尤其是在解析翻译起始方面。

title: Task-specific fine-tuning versus frontier large language models for RoB 2 risk of bias assessment: development and external benchmark evaluation of RoB-BERT
zh_title: 微调模型与前沿大模型评估RoB 2偏倚风险的对比
summary: 开发微调系统RoB-BERT，并在419份已发表人工评估上与三个前沿大模型比较RoB 2评定一致性。
key_points: 基于5304份经审核评估训练，测试试验不参与训练
逐条回答22个信号问题并引用原文证据句
按官方RoB 2算法给出领域与总体判定
reason: 预印本，有外部基准与人工评估对照、规模较大，但非临床结局
abstract: Background: Researchers increasingly use large language models (LLMs) to assess risk of bias in randomized trials, but how task-specific fine-tuned models compare with frontier models remains uncertain. Objective: To develop RoB-BERT, a fine-tuned RoB 2 assessment system, and to compare its agreement with human assessments against that of three frontier LLMs. Methods: RoB 2 rates five bias domains and the trial overall as low risk, some concerns or high risk, based on answers to 22 signalling questions. RoB-BERT answers each question, quotes the supporting sentences from the trial report, and applies the official RoB 2 algorithm. We trained RoB-BERT on 5,304 reviewer-checked assessments, none from a test trial, and compared it with Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-6 Astra and Gemini 4 Argon, each given identical prompts and text, against 419 published human assessments (ROBoto2, LogiMed-RoB and Cochrane reviews) made without AI assistance. Each reference was the single published judgement for that trial, made by one assessor or agreed by two, rather than an expert reference standard, so we also report agreement between two human assessors of the same trial. Results: In ROBoto2, pairs of human assessors who rated the same trial agreed on 61.2% to 64.7% of domain judgements ({kappa} 0.15 to 0.35) and 46.2% to 50.0% of overall judgements ({kappa} 0.15 to 0.17); across the 185 ROBoto2 trials, RoB-BERT agreed with the human judgement on 67.4% ({kappa} 0.35) and 53.5% ({kappa} 0.20). Across all 419 assessments, domain agreement was 67.9% ({kappa} 0.29) for RoB-BERT, 65.0% ({kappa} 0.24) for Claude Fable 5.1, 52.7% ({kappa} 0.21) for GPT-6 Astra and 66.7% ({kappa} 0.26) for Gemini 4 Argon; overall agreement was 46.1% ({kappa} 0.16), 47.3% ({kappa} 0.17), 31.0% ({kappa} 0.03) and 46.5% ({kappa} 0.14), respectively. For domains the reference rated high risk, sensitivity was 22.2% for RoB-BERT, 23.1% for Claude Fable 5.1, 41.9% for GPT-6 Astra and 24.8% for Gemini 4 Argon, with specificity of 92.5%, 92.8%, 80.0% and 95.0%. On the 52 ROBoto2 trials rated by two assessors, the second assessor's sensitivity for the reference assessor's high-risk domains was 23.1% (specificity 90.3%) and RoB-BERT's was 30.8% (specificity 92.7%). RoB-BERT located 95.7% of its quotations verbatim in the report and cost US$0.005 per trial, 2% to 6% of the frontier models' cost. Conclusions: RoB-BERT agreed with single human assessors at least as closely as two human assessors agreed with each other,
zh_abstract: 【背景】研究者越来越多地使用大语言模型（LLMs）评估随机试验的偏倚风险，但任务特定微调模型与前沿模型相比如何仍不确定。【目的】开发RoB-BERT，一个微调的RoB 2评估系统，并将其与人类评估的一致性同三种前沿LLMs进行比较。【方法】RoB 2基于对22个信号问题的回答，将五个偏倚领域和试验总体评为低风险、一些担忧或高风险。RoB-BERT回答每个问题，引用试验报告中支持性句子，并应用官方RoB 2算法。我们在5,304项经评审员核查的评估上训练RoB-BERT，其中无一项来自测试试验；并将其与Claude Fable 5.1、GPT-6 Astra和Gemini 4 Argon进行比较，每个模型均获得相同提示和文本，对照419项已发表的、在无AI辅助下完成的人类评估（ROBoto2、LogiMed-RoB和Cochrane综述）。每个参考均为该试验的单一已发表判定，由一名评估者作出或由两名评估者达成一致，而非专家参考标准，因此我们还报告同一试验两名人类评估者之间的一致性。【结果】在ROBoto2中，对同一试验评分的人类评估者配对在61.2%至64.7%的领域判定（{kappa} 0.15至0.35）和46.2%至50.0%的总体判定（{kappa} 0.15至0.17）上一致；在185项ROBoto2试验中，RoB-BERT与人类判定的一致性分别为67.4%（{kappa} 0.35）和53.5%（{kappa} 0.20）。在所有419项评估中，领域一致性为RoB-BERT 67.9%（{kappa} 0.29）、Claude Fable 5.1 65.0%（{kappa} 0.24）、GPT-6 Astra 52.7%（{kappa} 0.21）和Gemini 4 Argon 66.7%（{kappa} 0.26）；总体一致性分别为46.1%（{kappa} 0.16）、47.3%（{kappa} 0.17）、31.0%（{kappa} 0.03）和46.5%（{kappa} 0.14）。对于参考评为高风险的领域，敏感性为RoB-BERT 22.2%、Claude Fable 5.1 23.1%、GPT-6 Astra 41.9%和Gemini 4 Argon 24.8%，特异性分别为92.5%、92.8%、80.0%和95.0%。在由两名评估者评定的52项ROBoto2试验中，第二名评估者相对于参考评估者高风险领域的敏感性为23.1%（特异性90.3%），RoB-BERT为30.8%（特异性92.7%）。RoB-BERT的引文中有95.7%可在报告中逐字定位，每项试验成本为0.005美元，为前沿模型成本的2%至6%。【结论】RoB-BERT与单个人类评估者的一致性至少与两名人类评估者彼此之间的一致性相当，

title: Foundation Model and Radiomics Distance Scores for Post-Hoc Segmentation Failure Detection
zh_title: 基础模型与影像组学距离分数用于分割失败检测
summary: 预印本提出基于马氏距离的两种事后失败分数，分别用影像组学形状特征与冻结DINOv3特征，在多中心前列腺与海马MRI协议及人群偏移下评估。
key_points: 两种失败分数：掩膜影像组学特征与掩膜感知基础模型特征
无需配准或访问模型内部即可事后检测分割失败
在多个中心的前列腺与海马MRI偏移场景中测试
reason: 预印本新方法，含多中心与分布偏移外部场景测试，但证据尚有限
abstract: Medical image segmentation models can fail silently when clinical data differs from training data. Deployed models rarely ship with quality control, and are often black boxes. Prior methods that work in this post-hoc failure detection setting still need a separate regression or segmentation model, registration, or access to model internals. We instead propose two failure scores based on the Mahalanobis distance to a labeled reference set. The first uses radiomic shape features of the predicted mask. The second uses frozen foundation model (FM) features, made mask-aware by overlaying the mask on the image, encoding it with a frozen DINOv3, and pooling patch features with more weight on the mask region. We test on multi-site prostate and hippocampus MRI under imaging-protocol and population shift. Ranking cases by predicted failure risk within each site, both scores are competitive with the registration-based (Atlas-RCA) and ensemble-based (pairwise Dice) baselines, without registration that can fail silently or access to individual predictions. Our results show that pooling all test cases into one ranking, as prior work does, rewards ordering sites by difficulty, so a detector can rank sites well, miss failures within them, and still look strong. Within-site evaluation measures true per-case failure. The two evaluation schemes reward different behavior, so we recommend reporting both. The code is available at https://github.com/imigraz/fm-radiomics-failure-detection.
zh_abstract: 当临床数据与训练数据不同时，医学图像分割模型可能静默失败。已部署的模型很少附带质量控制，且往往是黑箱。在此事后失败检测设置中有效的既往方法仍需要单独的回归或分割模型、配准，或访问模型内部信息。我们转而提出两种基于到有标签参考集的马氏距离的失败评分。第一种使用预测掩膜的影像组学形状特征。第二种使用冻结的基础模型（FM）特征，通过将掩膜叠加到图像上使其具备掩膜感知，用冻结的DINOv3进行编码，并对图像块特征进行池化且赋予掩膜区域更高权重。我们在成像协议和人群分布偏移下的多站点前列腺和海马MRI上进行测试。在每个站点内按预测失败风险对病例排序时，两种评分均与基于配准的（Atlas-RCA）和基于集成的（pairwise Dice）基线相当，且无需可能静默失败的配准，也无需访问单个预测。我们的结果表明，将所有测试病例合并为一个排序（如既往工作所做）会奖励按难度对站点排序，因此检测器可以很好地对站点排序、漏掉站点内失败，却仍显得表现很强。站点内评估衡量真实的逐病例失败。两种评估方案奖励不同行为，因此我们建议两者都报告。代码见 https://github.com/imigraz/fm-radiomics-failure-detection。

title: PathStream: Towards Streaming Diagnostic Copilots for Whole-Slide Pathology
zh_title: PathStream：全切片病理流式诊断副驾驶
summary: 预印本记录5位病理医师在1791张全切片上的阅片轨迹，构建基准并提出流式诊断副驾驶模型。
key_points: 数据覆盖十个器官的1791张TCGA全切片
构建PathStreamBench评估响应时机与描述
副驾驶在医师主导导航下综合累积证据
reason: 较大规模病理阅片轨迹基准与新任务设定，但为预印本且外部验证未述
abstract: Pathologists reach a diagnosis by integrating morphological evidence across regions and magnifications along viewing trajectories. Existing pathology AI rarely reflects this process: models predict from selected image regions, answer questions within fixed visual contexts, or navigate slides autonomously. We formalize pathologist-led streaming diagnosis, in which the pathologist controls navigation while a copilot selectively describes incoming views and synthesizes accumulated evidence into a final diagnosis. We record five pathologists' viewing trajectories on 1,791 TCGA whole-slide images (WSIs) spanning ten organs, with response labels, morphological descriptions, and session-level findings and diagnoses. We construct PathStreamBench to assess response timing, morphological description, and session-level diagnosis, alongside auxiliary video understanding. We introduce PathStream, which jointly learns streaming responses and diagnosis through two-stage training, with a diagnosis-attention loss guiding attention during diagnosis to relevant visual and textual evidence accumulated as the examination unfolds. PathStream outperforms 14 vision-language models and three domain-fine-tuned baselines on the core tasks, achieving a trajectory WSI Relevance score of 77.87, surpassing the strongest domain-fine-tuned baseline's 62.76. Without additional training, its diagnostic capabilities generalize to new educational pathology videos, three external centers, and an unseen organ.
zh_abstract: 病理学家通过沿观察轨迹整合跨区域和跨放大倍数的形态学证据来作出诊断。现有病理 AI 很少反映这一过程：模型从选定的图像区域进行预测、在固定视觉情境内回答问题，或自主浏览切片。我们形式化了病理学家主导的流式诊断（pathologist-led streaming diagnosis），其中病理学家控制导航，而副驾驶（copilot）选择性地描述到来的视图，并将累积证据综合为最终诊断。我们记录了五位病理学家在涵盖十个器官的 1,791 张 TCGA 全切片图像（WSIs）上的观察轨迹，包含响应标签、形态学描述以及会话级发现和诊断。我们构建 PathStreamBench 以评估响应时机、形态学描述和会话级诊断，并辅以视频理解。我们提出 PathStream，其通过两阶段训练联合学习流式响应和诊断，并使用诊断注意力损失在诊断过程中引导注意力关注随着检查展开而累积的相关视觉和文本证据。PathStream 在核心任务上优于 14 个视觉-语言模型和三个领域微调基线，取得轨迹 WSI Relevance 分数 77.87，超过最强领域微调基线的 62.76。无需额外训练，其诊断能力可泛化到新的教育病理视频、三个外部中心和未见过的器官。

title: Benchmarking VLM Medical Hallucination across 5 Modalities
zh_title: Multi-Med：跨五模态医学视觉语言模型幻觉基准
summary: 发布含1000组图像-问题对、覆盖五种影像模态的医学幻觉基准Multi-Med，并评测10个视觉语言模型在四类问题上表现。
key_points: 基准覆盖五种医学影像模态
评测10个常用视觉语言模型
各模态与问题类型表现差异明显
最优模型间差异无统计显著性
reason: 公开多模态幻觉基准且系统评测10个模型，但为预印本、规模中等
abstract: Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) within the medical domain remain a difficult and not well-understood problem, and it is still unclear where these models break down. Although several benchmarks targeting medical hallucination have been introduced, they often lack broad coverage across different medical imaging modalities. We introduce Multi-Med, a medical hallucination benchmark containing 1,000 image-question pairs spanning five distinct modalities. Using this benchmark, we perform an in-depth experimental study of 10 widely used VLMs across five modalities and four question categories. Our findings indicate that model performance differs substantially depending on the imaging modality and question type, and that the differences among the best-performing models are not statistically significant.
zh_abstract: 医学领域视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）中的幻觉仍是一个困难且尚未被充分理解的问题，并且这些模型在何处失效仍不清楚。尽管已经提出了若干针对医学幻觉的基准，但它们通常缺乏跨不同医学影像模态的广泛覆盖。我们推出 Multi-Med，一个包含 1,000 个图像-问题对、跨越五种不同模态的医学幻觉基准。利用该基准，我们对 10 个广泛使用的 VLM 在五种模态和四类问题上进行了深入的实验研究。我们的发现表明，模型性能因影像模态和问题类型而存在显著差异，并且表现最佳的模型之间的差异无统计学意义。

title: PsyDrift: Healthy-Reference Latent Diffusion for Anomaly Scoring in Autism Spectrum Disorder
zh_title: PsyDrift：健康参考潜扩散的自闭症异常评分
summary: 结合功能连接表征与仅用健康样本训练的扩散模型，以重构偏离度作为自闭症连续异常评分。
key_points: 仅用健康样本训练DDPM，输出连续偏离分数
ABIDE-I全部20站点、1102名受试者留一站点验证
分类器平均站点AUROC为0.798
reason: 20站点留一站点验证、样本超千例，但为预印本且仅研究性指标
abstract: Individual heterogeneity and acquisition-site variability complicate neuroimaging-based characterization of autism spectrum disorder (ASD). We propose PsyDrift, combining ASD/healthy-control-supervised functional-connectivity representations with healthy-reference latent diffusion. An encoder produces 128-dimensional representations, and a denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) learns exclusively from healthy training latents. Distance from a diffusion-denoised reconstruction provides a continuous deviation score. We evaluate 1,102 subjects from all 20 ABIDE-I sites using five-seed leave-one-site-out cross-validation. The classifier and DDPM achieve mean-site AUROCs of $0.798 \pm 0.003$ and $0.718 \pm 0.013$, respectively; uncertainties denote seed standard deviations. Matched healthy-reference scorers on the same representation achieve 0.68-0.71; the statistical significance of diffusion's modest numerical advantage remains unestablished. Within ASD, scores show weak associations with ADOS Total (Spearman $ρ= 0.108$, $p = 0.038$) and full-scale IQ ($ρ= -0.138$, $p = 0.002$), without adjustment for age, sex, site, or head motion. Frozen evaluation without retraining or hyperparameter adaptation yields pooled AUROCs of 0.69 on ABIDE-II and 0.61 on ADHD-200, providing preliminary evidence of cross-cohort and cross-disorder transfer. These results demonstrate healthy-reference deviation scoring within an ASD-supervised representation; incremental predictive and clinical value remains unestablished.
zh_abstract: 个体异质性和采集站点变异性使基于神经影像的自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）刻画复杂化。我们提出 PsyDrift，将 ASD/健康对照监督的功能连接表征与健康参考的潜在扩散相结合。编码器产生 128 维表征，去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）仅从健康训练潜在变量中学习。与扩散去噪重建的距离提供连续偏差分数。我们使用五种子留一站点交叉验证评估来自全部 20 个 ABIDE-I 站点的 1,102 名受试者。分类器和 DDPM 分别达到平均站点 AUROC 0.798 ± 0.003 和 0.718 ± 0.013；不确定性表示种子标准差。在相同表征上匹配的健康参考评分器达到 0.68–0.71；扩散模型适度数值优势的统计显著性仍未确立。在 ASD 内部，分数与 ADOS 总分（Spearman ρ = 0.108，p = 0.038）和全量表智商（ρ = -0.138，p = 0.002）显示弱关联，未对年龄、性别、站点或头动进行调整。在不重新训练或超参数适应的情况下进行冻结评估，在 ABIDE-II 上得到汇总 AUROC 0.69，在 ADHD-200 上为 0.61，提供跨队列和跨疾病迁移的初步证据。这些结果表明了在 ASD 监督表征内的健康参考偏差评分；增量预测与临床价值仍未确立。

title: Development, validation, and evaluation of an LLM-assisted scoring rubric for nursing students' responses to ethical dilemmas.
zh_title: LLM辅助护理伦理开放题评分量表的开发与验证
summary: 基于GLM-5.2构建护理伦理解答评分量表，对312名学生1247份开放题作答进行回顾性评分与结构效度检验。
key_points: 量表经两轮专家评审，映射为六个维度
312名学生、13个伦理情境共1247份作答
在WorkBuddy平台以少样本方式实现自动评分
reason: 单队列回顾性验证，样本可观但无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [Nurse education today] To develop the Nursing Ethical Scoring Assessment (NESA), a prototype LLM-assisted scoring rubric, and to examine whether its scores provide defensible evidence for the proposed construct structure. Scoring nursing students' open-ended responses to ethical dilemmas relies on individual teacher review, which is difficult to scale. Large language models (LLM) can automate scoring, but their performance on such responses requires empirical examination. A retrospective descriptive study. The rubric was constructed by mapping published instruments onto six dimensions, revised through two rounds of expert review, and implemented as a customized skill on the WorkBuddy platform using the GLM-5.2 model (General Language Model version 5.2, developed by Zhipu AI) with few-shot examples. A total of 1247 written responses to 13 ethical dilemma scenarios were collected from 312 second-year nursing students at a vocational nursing college. A stratified 20% subsample was independently scored by two teachers (inter-rater ICC = 0.68-0.81). The institutional ethics committee granted a waiver of full ethical review (No. RT2025-09; 30 September 2025) using de-identified, minimal-risk educational records. Scores concentrated at the low end, mainly because responses were extremely short (mean 19.8 characters). Response length was strongly correlated with total score (ρ = 0.829). After length control, residualized inter-dimensional correlations ranged from -0.09 to 0.412. Dimension-level AI-human agreement was weak to moderate in rank order (Spearman ρ = 0.319-0.690) and poor to moderate in absolute agreement (ICC = 0.300-0.654); total-score ρ was higher (0.761), and human scores averaged 2.34 points higher than AI scores. Total scores, stance orientation, and performance-level distributions differed significantly across dilemma types, with a significant length-by-dilemma interaction. The NESA rubric is feasible as a prototype framework for LLM-assisted evaluation of ethical written responses. Response length, evidence sufficiency, and AI-human calibration must be addressed before ethical reasoning can be reliably scored from short texts.
zh_abstract: [Nurse education today] 开发护理伦理评分评估（Nursing Ethical Scoring Assessment, NESA），一种原型 LLM 辅助评分量规，并检验其评分是否为所提出的构念结构提供可辩护的证据。对护理学生对伦理困境的开放式回答进行评分依赖于教师个人评审，这难以规模化。大语言模型（LLM）可以自动化评分，但其在此类回答上的表现需要实证检验。一项回顾性描述性研究。该量规通过将已发表工具映射到六个维度构建，经两轮专家评审修订，并在 WorkBuddy 平台上使用 GLM-5.2 模型（General Language Model version 5.2，由 Zhipu AI 开发）结合少样本示例实现为定制技能。从一所职业护理学院的 312 名二年级护理学生中收集了针对 13 个伦理困境场景的共 1247 份书面回答。分层 20% 子样本由两名教师独立评分（评分者间 ICC = 0.68-0.81）。机构伦理委员会使用去标识化、最小风险的教育记录，批准豁免完整伦理审查（编号 RT2025-09；2025 年 9 月 30 日）。分数集中在低端，主要因为回答极短（平均 19.8 个字符）。回答长度与总分强相关（ρ = 0.829）。控制长度后，残差化维度间相关性范围为 -0.09 至 0.412。维度层面 AI-人类一致性在排序上为弱至中等（Spearman ρ = 0.319-0.690），在绝对一致性上为差至中等（ICC = 0.300-0.654）；总分 ρ 较高（0.761），且人类评分平均比 AI 评分高 2.34 分。总分、立场取向和表现水平分布在困境类型间差异显著，并存在显著的长度×困境类型交互作用。NESA 量规作为 LLM 辅助评估伦理书面回答的原型框架是可行的。在能够从短文本可靠评分伦理推理之前，必须解决回答长度、证据充分性和 AI-人类校准问题。

title: SleepXA: Composing Pretrained Neural and Cardiac Foundation Models for Sleep Representation Learning
zh_title: SleepXA：组合预训练神经与心脏基础模型
summary: 用同步多导睡眠图组合预训练EEG与ECG基础模型，在9230条夜间记录上预训练，并评测27项下游任务。
key_points: 组合预训练EEG与ECG编码器，而非从头训练
基于三个队列9230条PSG记录预训练
在27项下游任务上评估
reason: 大规模多队列预训练与多任务评测，但为预印本，属值得一看
abstract: Physiological signals recorded during sleep provide synchronized views of neural, cardiac, respiratory, and other bodily systems, while preserving modality-specific information. Existing EEG and ECG foundation models already capture rich but distinct physiological structure, motivating an alternative to training a multimodal sleep model from scratch: composing existing pretrained models. We introduce SleepXA, a framework that uses synchronized polysomnography (PSG) to compose independently pretrained neural and cardiac foundation models. SleepXA combines pretrained EEG and ECG encoders with lightweight encoders for additional PSG modalities, and learns shared and modality-specific representations through sleep-guided alignment. We pretrain SleepXA on 9,230 overnight PSG recordings from three large cohorts and evaluate it on 27 downstream tasks spanning sleep representation, clinical and disease prediction, and daytime physiological transfer. SleepXA ranks among the top two methods on 22 of 27 tasks. Controlled experiments further show consistent benefits across sensor configurations and EEG-ECG backbone choices, while pretrained initialization outperforms architecture-matched training from scratch and SleepXA surpasses alternative multimodal composition strategies. These results suggest that synchronized multimodal physiology can serve as a natural interface for composing existing physiological foundation models, yielding reusable representations that extend beyond sleep to clinical and daytime physiological settings.
zh_abstract: 睡眠期间记录的生理信号提供了神经、心脏、呼吸及其他身体系统的同步视图，同时保留了各模态特有的信息。现有的EEG和ECG基础模型已经捕捉到丰富但各不相同的生理结构，这促使人们寻找一种替代从头训练多模态睡眠模型的方法：组合现有的预训练模型。我们提出SleepXA，这是一个利用同步多导睡眠图（PSG）来组合独立预训练的神经和心脏基础模型的框架。SleepXA将预训练的EEG和ECG编码器与用于其他PSG模态的轻量编码器相结合，并通过睡眠引导的对齐学习共享表征和模态特异性表征。我们在来自三个大型队列的9,230份整夜PSG记录上预训练SleepXA，并在涵盖睡眠表征、临床与疾病预测以及日间生理迁移的27项下游任务上对其进行评估。SleepXA在27项任务中的22项上位列前两种方法之一。受控实验进一步表明，在不同传感器配置和EEG-ECG主干选择下均有一致获益，而预训练初始化优于架构匹配的从头训练，且SleepXA优于其他多模态组合策略。这些结果表明，同步多模态生理信号可作为组合现有生理基础模型的自然接口，产生可复用的表征，其应用范围超越睡眠，延伸至临床和日间生理场景。

title: Pain Reassessment from Pulse Waveforms with Language Model Explanations
zh_title: 脉搏波疼痛再评估及语言模型解释
summary: 在MIMIC-III与MC-MED共52082次报告关联评估中，用纵向PPG表征做疼痛再评估并附语言模型解释。
key_points: 两大数据集共5.2万次报告关联评估
含历史脉搏表征的模型平均精度约0.82
去掉历史表征后四小时一致性由0.718降至0.534
reason: 跨两个医疗系统大样本外部验证，但为预印本且无临床结局，属值得一看
abstract: Routine photoplethysmography (PPG) offers a continuous physiological signal for pain reassessment between self-reports. Whether prior recordings provide an individualized physiological reference beyond care-process timing remains unresolved. Across 52,082 report-linked assessments from 21,514 patients in MIMIC-III critical care and MC-MED emergency care, we evaluate a workflow that pairs longitudinal PPG representations with local evidence-linked language interpretation. Among 27 methods, source-selected full-history models achieved average precision of 0.824 from critical to emergency care and 0.822 in reverse. Removing historical pulse-run representations while retaining reassessment availability and elapsed time lowered critical-to-emergency four-hour within-patient concordance from 0.718 to 0.534. This comparison supports the contribution of prior pulse-run representations to within-patient ordering beyond timing cues. Across 2,905 test patients, a local Qwen model interpreting frozen predictions achieved a 94.7% patient-equal pass rate on automated evidence checks after at most one revision. Longitudinal pulse context and evidence-linked language interpretation support a patient-centred workflow for pain reassessment.
zh_abstract: 常规光电容积脉搏波（PPG）提供了一种连续生理信号，可用于在自我报告之间重新评估疼痛。既往记录是否能提供超越照护流程时间信息的个体化生理参考，仍未得到解决。在来自MIMIC-III重症监护和MC-MED急诊的21,514名患者的52,082次与报告关联的评估中，我们评估了一种将纵向PPG表征与本地证据关联的语言解读相配对的工作流程。在27种方法中，按来源选择的全历史模型在从重症监护到急诊场景中达到平均精度0.824，反向场景为0.822。在保留再评估可用性和经过时间的同时移除历史脉搏段表征，使从重症监护到急诊的四小时患者内一致性从0.718降至0.534。这一比较支持既往脉搏段表征对患者内排序的贡献超越时间线索。在2,905名测试患者中，一个本地Qwen模型对冻结预测进行解读，在最多一次修订后，在自动化证据检查中达到94.7%的患者等权通过率。纵向脉搏背景和证据关联的语言解读支持一种以患者为中心的疼痛再评估工作流程。

title: Seeing Is Not Acting: WARD Diagnoses the Evidence-to-State-to-Action Gap in Longitudinal Clinical Agents
zh_title: WARD：纵向临床智能体证据到行动的评测基准
summary: 发布WARD基准，用4560项任务评估临床智能体如何将累积证据转化为病情判断与及时安全行动。
key_points: 涵盖7个临床输出域、40条纵向轨迹、95次住院
纵向轨道控制累积证据，交互轨道评测工具化全程管理
含271条可核验证据项与141个参考状态转换
在12个模型上评测，关注中间环节失败而非仅最终结果
reason: 规模较大、设计细致的智能体评测基准，但为预印本且证据获取方式受限
abstract: Large language models for longitudinal clinical care must revise their assessments and actions as patient information accumulates. However, benchmarks centered on isolated responses or final task outcomes provide limited insight into intermediate failures in evidence use, state updating, and action selection. We introduce WARD, a benchmark for evaluating how clinical agents translate accumulating evidence into patient-state judgments and timely, safe actions. WARD comprises 4,560 clinical tasks across seven clinical output domains, organized into 240 checkpoints from 40 longitudinal clinical trajectories spanning 95 hospitalizations. Its Longitudinal Track evaluates these tasks under controlled cumulative evidence. Its Interactive Track evaluates end-to-end, tool-mediated clinical management across 271 verifiable evidence items and 141 reference transitions. Across 12 models with scorable checkpoint outputs, evidence recognition consistently outpaces downstream state and action decisions, with linked-evidence nonresponse reaching 74.47--90.90\%. Models also struggle to retain and update information over time, while in the Interactive Track only 11.46\% of executed actions advance a reference transition. These results reveal a persistent evidence-to-state-to-action gap and highlight the need for process-level evaluation of longitudinal clinical agents.Code and data: https://github.com/Dingsuper-creator/WARD.
zh_abstract: 用于纵向临床照护的大语言模型必须随着患者信息的积累而修正其评估和行动。然而，以孤立响应或最终任务结局为中心的基准测试，对证据使用、状态更新和行动选择中的中间失败所提供的洞见有限。我们介绍了 WARD，一个用于评估临床智能体如何将不断积累的证据转化为患者状态判断以及及时、安全行动的基准。WARD 包含跨越七个临床输出领域的 4,560 项临床任务，组织为来自 40 条纵向临床轨迹（涵盖 95 次住院）的 240 个检查点。其纵向轨道（Longitudinal Track）在受控的累积证据下评估这些任务。其交互轨道（Interactive Track）评估端到端、工具介导的临床管理，涵盖 271 个可验证证据条目和 141 个参考转换。在 12 个具有可评分检查点输出的模型中，证据识别始终超过下游状态和行动决策，链接证据无响应率达到 74.47–90.90%。模型也难以随时间保留和更新信息，而在交互轨道中，仅 11.46% 的执行行动推动了参考转换。这些结果揭示了持续存在的从证据到状态再到行动的差距，并凸显了对纵向临床智能体进行过程级评估的必要性。代码和数据：https://github.com/Dingsuper-creator/WARD。

title: Elicitation format changes zero-shot classification accuracy in a medical vision-language model: a two-center evaluation on colorectal histopathology
zh_title: 提问格式改变医学视觉语言模型零样本准确率
summary: 两中心结直肠病理评估显示，要求输出九类概率而非前三类排序使MedGemma-27b-it准确率显著下降。
key_points: 在10004张验证集与7180张外部中心PathMNIST切片上评测
九类概率格式准确率下降14.8与13.4个百分点
去除禁止推理与给出答案的限制后准确率回升约0.19
预先注册终点，设置随机基线与随机打破平局
reason: 含外部中心验证与预注册设计，但为预印本且仅测模型输出格式效应
abstract: Background. Verbalized confidence from a hosted medical vision-language model is usually treated as packaging around an unchanged prediction. Methods. We held a nine-class colorectal histopathology prompt fixed except for the requested response format and evaluated MedGemma-27b-it on 10,004 validation and 7,180 external-center PathMNIST patches, with preregistered endpoints, randomized ties, and random floors recomputed for each patch set. Results. Requesting probabilities over all nine classes instead of a ranked top-3 reduced accuracy by 14.8 points on validation, -0.1475 [-0.1594, -0.1353], and 13.4 at the external center, -0.1341 [-0.1484, -0.1196], against chance accuracy of 0.1111. The nine-class prompt uniquely forbade commentary, reasoning, and a chosen answer; removing that prohibition at matched cardinality and token budget recovered +0.1878 [+0.1623, +0.2134] and +0.1911 [+0.1648, +0.2181], while changing cardinality with the prohibition absent moved accuracy by -0.0013 [-0.0300, +0.0280] and -0.0214 [-0.0494, +0.0071]. The nine-class format returned no parseable distribution on 7.6 and 7.7 percent of patches, mostly zero vectors in the two least-textured classes, and deferring these failures first explained its measurable selective-prediction gain. Across four vision-capable models, accuracy did not grade the cost: two models matched on accuracy differed five- to sevenfold. First-token logit entropy routed better than any elicited signal, +0.1820 [+0.1722, +0.1974] versus +0.0493 [+0.0377, +0.0649] relative to each signal's random floor. Conclusions. Response format changes a medical vision-language classifier, and the operative component here was the instruction suppressing an answer. Use logits when available; otherwise request a short ranked list without prohibiting reasoning or a chosen answer.
zh_abstract: 【背景】来自托管式医学视觉语言模型的语言化置信度通常被视为对未改变预测的包装。【方法】我们保持九分类结直肠组织病理学提示词固定，仅改变所要求的回答格式，并在 10,004 个验证集和 7,180 个外部中心 PathMNIST 图像块上评估 MedGemma-27b-it，采用预注册终点、随机化平局处理，以及针对每个图像块集重新计算的随机下限。【结果】要求输出全部九个类别的概率而非排名前三，使验证集准确率降低 14.8 个百分点，-0.1475 [-0.1594, -0.1353]，外部中心降低 13.4 个百分点，-0.1341 [-0.1484, -0.1196]，而随机准确率为 0.1111。九分类提示词独特地禁止评论、推理和选定答案；在匹配类别数和 token 预算下移除此禁令，恢复了 +0.1878 [+0.1623, +0.2134] 和 +0.1911 [+0.1648, +0.2181]，而在禁令不存在时改变类别数，使准确率变化 -0.0013 [-0.0300, +0.0280] 和 -0.0214 [-0.0494, +0.0071]。九分类格式在 7.6% 和 7.7% 的图像块上未返回可解析的分布，主要是两个纹理最少的类别中的零向量，将这些失败延迟处理首先解释了其可测量的选择性预测增益。在四个具备视觉能力的模型中，准确率并不能对成本进行分级：两个准确率相匹配的模型成本相差五到七倍。首个 token 的 logit 熵在路由方面优于任何诱导信号，相对于各信号的随机下限分别为 +0.1820 [+0.1722, +0.1974] 与 +0.0493 [+0.0377, +0.0649]。【结论】回答格式会改变医学视觉语言分类器，而此处的有效组件是抑制答案的指令。有 logits 时使用 logits；否则请求简短的排序列表，且不禁止推理或选定答案。

title: Reimagining inflammatory bowel disease in the age of artificial intelligence: discovery, care, education, and sustainability for the next decade.
zh_title: 观点：AI时代炎症性肠病的下一个十年
summary: 述评文章讨论多模态基础模型如何整合多组学与临床数据，重塑炎症性肠病的发现、诊疗与教育。

提出发现、治疗、照护、教育、可持续五个方向
未报告原始数据或实验结果

abstract: [Journal of Crohn's & colitis] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly evolving from task-specific algorithms to multimodal foundation models capable of integrating heterogeneous biological and clinical data across the health-care continuum. In inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), this transformation offers an unprecedented opportunity to move beyond fragmented analyses toward a unified understanding and management of disease. Artificial intelligence is emerging as the connective infrastructure linking scientific discovery, therapeutic development, patient care, education, and health-care delivery systems into continuously learning ecosystems. In this viewpoint, we explore how AI may reshape IBD over the next decade through 5 interconnected domains. Advances in multimodal AI accelerate biological discovery by integrating multiomics, spatial biology, and foundation models to identify mechanistic disease endotypes. Simultaneously, AI can shorten the path from molecular discovery to therapeutic innovation by supporting target identification, predicting protein structure, drug positioning, and adaptive clinical trial design. These scientific advances converge at the bedside, where multimodal AI may transform patient care from reactive management to predictive precision medicine through integrated diagnostics, digital biomarkers, real-time monitoring and individualized risk prediction. Beyond clinical care, AI is redefining medical education by enabling adaptive learning, explainable decision support, and democratized specialist expertise, while contributing to sustainable health care through optimized resource allocation, workforce support, and continuously learning systems. Realizing this vision will require robust governance, interoperability, prospective validation, and equitable implementation. If responsibly deployed, AI holds the potential to redefine IBD diagnosis, classification, therapeutic strategies and management within an intelligent ecosystem able to accelerate discovery, personalize care, and improve outcomes for patients and health-care systems alike.
zh_abstract: 【Journal of Crohn's & colitis】人工智能（AI）正迅速从任务特定算法演变为能够整合整个医疗保健连续体中异质性生物学和临床数据的多模态基础模型。在炎症性肠病（IBD）中，这一转变提供了前所未有的机会，使人们能够超越碎片化分析，转向对疾病的统一理解和管理。人工智能正在成为连接性基础设施，将科学发现、治疗开发、患者护理、教育和医疗保健提供系统连接成持续学习的生态系统。在这篇观点文章中，我们通过 5 个相互关联的领域探讨 AI 在未来十年可能如何重塑 IBD。多模态 AI 的进展通过整合多组学、空间生物学和基础模型来识别机制性疾病内型，从而加速生物学发现。同时，AI 可通过支持靶点识别、预测蛋白质结构、药物定位和适应性临床试验设计，缩短从分子发现到治疗创新的路径。这些科学进展汇聚于床旁，多模态 AI 可能通过整合诊断、数字生物标志物、实时监测和个体化风险预测，将患者护理从反应性管理转变为预测性精准医学。超越临床护理，AI 正在通过实现自适应学习、可解释决策支持和专业化专家知识的普及化来重新定义医学教育，同时通过优化资源分配、劳动力支持和持续学习系统为可持续医疗保健作出贡献。实现这一愿景将需要稳健的治理、互操作性、前瞻性验证和公平实施。如果负责任地部署，AI 有潜力在一个能够加速发现、个性化护理并改善患者和医疗保健系统结局的智能生态系统中重新定义 IBD 的诊断、分类、治疗策略和管理。

title: Real-Time Prediction of Cardiac Parameters Using Livestream Transthoracic Echocardiography Images: A Feasibility Study.
zh_title: 实时超声图像自动分割与心脏参数预测可行性研究
summary: 研究构建实时超声图像采集分析流程，用UNet自动分割左心室并预测心脏参数，在三个数据集上评估。
key_points: 搭建实时超声图像采集与分析软件流程
UNet用两个公开数据集和一个自建数据集训练
三种损失函数模型分别在三个测试集独立评估
reason: 同行评审但属单中心可行性研究，仅内部与公开数据验证，无临床结局，增量档
abstract: [Ultrasound in medicine & biology] The aim of this study is to develop a workflow for acquiring and analyzing livestream echocardiography images from a GE HealthCare Vivid E95 system, a real-time artificial intelligence (AI)-based automatic left ventricle segmentation, and cardiac parameter prediction. The system provides automated echocardiography image analysis independent of electrocardiogram signals. A software pipeline was developed to acquire and analyze livestream echocardiography images from the ultrasound system. A UNet neural network model was trained using publicly available datasets (CAMUS, EchoNet-Dynamic) and an in-house dataset (Physical Activity and Fitness in Childhood Cancer Survivors). AI models were trained using these three datasets and three loss functions, with each model evaluated independently on all three test datasets. The model with the highest Dice score on the test datasets was selected and used to process livestream echocardiography images throughout the entire cardiac cycle. The resulting segmentation masks were used to compute the cardiac parameters. The offline-trained UNet models achieved an average Dice score of 0.9509. The livestream echocardiography image prediction showed average ejection fractions of 48%, 48% and 56%, corresponding to the Simpson's single-plane, area-length and Bullet methods, respectively. In contrast, EchoPAC (the GE HealthCare software tool to compute cardiac parameters) showed an average ejection fraction of 55% in nine volunteers with no known cardiac diseases. This study shows the feasibility of AI-assisted echocardiographic image analysis based on livestream echocardiography. However, the accuracy of the obtained cardiac parameters needs improvement to align with clinical standards.
zh_abstract: [Ultrasound in medicine & biology] 本研究旨在开发一个工作流程，用于从GE HealthCare Vivid E95系统获取并分析实时流式超声心动图图像，进行基于人工智能（AI）的实时自动左心室分割以及心脏参数预测。该系统提供独立于心电图信号的自动化超声心动图图像分析。我们开发了一个软件流水线，用于从超声系统获取并分析实时流式超声心动图图像。使用公开数据集（CAMUS、EchoNet-Dynamic）和一个内部数据集（Physical Activity and Fitness in Childhood Cancer Survivors）训练了一个UNet神经网络模型。使用这三个数据集和三种损失函数训练AI模型，每个模型均在所有三个测试数据集上独立评估。选择在测试数据集上Dice评分最高的模型，用于处理整个心动周期的实时流式超声心动图图像。所得分割掩膜用于计算心脏参数。离线训练的UNet模型平均Dice评分为0.9509。实时流式超声心动图图像预测显示平均射血分数分别为48%、48%和56%，对应辛普森单平面法、面积-长度法和Bullet法。相比之下，EchoPAC（GE HealthCare用于计算心脏参数的软件工具）在9名无已知心脏病的志愿者中显示平均射血分数为55%。本研究表明基于实时流式超声心动图进行AI辅助超声心动图图像分析的可行性。然而，所获得心脏参数的准确性需要改进，以符合临床标准。

title: Designing large language model tutors to promote deep learning and precision medical education.
source: PubMed · Academic medicine : journal of the Association of American Medical Colleges
zh_title: 用LLM导师促进深度学习与精准医学教育
summary: 学术观点提出将LLM设计为“苏格拉底式镜子”导师，以学习科学促进医学生深度学习。
key_points: 担忧快速答案削弱深度学习与发现感
将LLM重构为苏格拉底式镜像导师
基于适度困难、社会建构主义等学习科学
reason: 学术观点文，无实证数据，属增量档
abstract: [Academic medicine : journal of the Association of American Medical Colleges] The rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs) by medical students has created two significant concerns: that students will use artificial intelligence (AI) for quick answers, short-circuiting the cognitive effort essential for deep learning, and that the satisfaction of discovery will be lost to algorithmic efficiency. This Scholarly Perspective reframes LLMs not as information retrieval systems, but as "Socratic Mirrors": interactive tutors grounded in established learning science (such as the desirable level of difficulty, social constructivism and zone of proximal development, the illusion of explanatory depth, and dual coding theory) that can restore the productive struggle that traditional LLMs often constrain. Drawing on the three functions of education framework, the authors argue that by handling qualification (the foundational work of content mastery), Socratic tutors free faculty to focus on what AI cannot provide: socialization (initiation into the norms and values of the profession) and subjectification (the formation of physicians as autonomous, ethical, and reflective practitioners). This potential is not merely theoretical. Empirical evidence from randomized controlled trials suggests that pedagogically engineered AI tutors, those designed to scaffold discovery rather than deliver answers, can significantly outperform traditional instruction. The studies demonstrate how LLMs configured as Socratic tutors can address the "2-Sigma" problem, offering personalized one-on-one tutoring at scale and moving medical education closer to the ideal of precision education. However, these studies are drawn from outside medical education, and the inferential leap to medical training, while theoretically grounded, remains empirically undemonstrated. The PICRAT (passive, interactive, creative, replacement, amplification, transformation) model is presented as a technology integration framework to ensure intentional rather than reactive AI integration. Together, these principles suggest a promising pathway toward scalable precision medical education that warrants formal evaluation in medical education contexts.
zh_abstract: [Academic medicine : journal of the Association of American Medical Colleges] 医学生对大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）的快速采用引发了两个重要担忧：学生将使用人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）获取快速答案，从而绕过深度学习所必需的认知努力；以及发现的满足感将被算法效率所取代。本学术观点（Scholarly Perspective）重新界定 LLMs，不将其视为信息检索系统，而将其视为“苏格拉底式镜子”（Socratic Mirrors）：基于既有学习科学（如合意难度水平、社会建构主义与最近发展区、解释深度错觉以及双重编码理论）的互动式导师，可恢复传统 LLMs 常常受限的富有成效的挣扎。借助教育三功能框架，作者认为，通过承担资格化（qualification，即内容掌握的基础工作），苏格拉底式导师使教师能够专注于 AI 无法提供的内容：社会化（socialization，即引导进入职业规范与价值）和主体化（subjectification，即培养医生成为自主、合乎伦理且善于反思的从业者）。这一潜力并非仅是理论上的。来自随机对照试验的实证证据表明，经过教学法工程设计的 AI 导师——即旨在为发现提供支架而非直接给出答案的导师——可以显著优于传统教学。这些研究证明，配置为苏格拉底式导师的 LLMs 如何能够解决“2-Sigma”问题，大规模提供个性化一对一辅导，并使医学教育更接近精准教育的理想。然而，这些研究来自医学教育之外，向医学培训的推断跳跃虽有理论依据，但仍未得到实证证明。PICRAT（passive、interactive、creative、replacement、amplification、transformation）模型被提出作为一种技术整合框架，以确保 AI 整合是有意的而非反应性的。总之，这些原则提示了一条通往可扩展精准医学教育的有前景路径，值得在医学教育情境中进行正式评估。

title: Artificial intelligence predictive medicine: geometric morphometrics in assisted scoliosis diagnosis.
source: PubMed · European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society
zh_title: 几何形态测量结合弹性网用于脊柱侧弯辅助诊断
summary: 回顾性研究用168名受试者三维躯干表面扫描的自动地标与弹性网回归，非侵入式识别青少年特发性脊柱侧弯。
key_points: 168人（135例侧弯、33例对照）回顾性横断面研究
地标提取后PCA降维再训练正则化回归
目标是减少筛查中对放射影像的暴露

abstract: [European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society] Accurate scoliosis screening is essential for early intervention and to minimize unnecessary exposure to radiographic imaging. This study presents a landmark-based approach using Geometric Morphometric Methods combined with Elastic Net regression for the automated, non-invasive detection of adolescent idiopathic scoliosis from 3D torso surface scans. A retrospective cross-sectional study was performed on 168 individuals (135 with adolescent idiopathic scoliosis and 33 controls) using automatic landmark extraction on surface meshes from previous studies. After dimensionality reduction via principal component analysis, the resulting shape variables were used to train a logistic regression model with regularization. The main outcome measures were Area Under the Curve, sensitivity, specificity and balanced accuracy to estimate the performance metrics of the Artificial Intelligence screening model. The model showed high discriminative ability on an unseen test dataset (Area Under the Curve = 0.926; 95% CI: 0.816-1.000). When a classification threshold derived exclusively from the training set was applied to the test set, sensitivity was 100%, specificity was 14.3%, and balanced accuracy was 57.1%. In contrast to deep learning models, this approach offers an interpretable framework based on anatomical landmarks and does not require large datasets or extensive computational resources. The findings support further investigation of surface trunk morphology as a source of discriminative information for AIS detection. External validation in larger and more representative populations is required before clinical screening application.
zh_abstract: [European spine journal：欧洲脊柱学会、欧洲脊柱畸形学会和颈椎研究学会欧洲分会的官方出版物] 准确的脊柱侧凸筛查对于早期干预和尽量减少不必要的放射影像暴露至关重要。本研究提出一种基于标志点的方法，使用几何形态测量学方法（Geometric Morphometric Methods）结合弹性网络（Elastic Net）回归，从三维躯干表面扫描中自动、无创地检测青少年特发性脊柱侧凸（adolescent idiopathic scoliosis, AIS）。研究对 168 名个体（135 例 AIS 患者和 33 名对照）进行了回顾性横断面研究，使用先前研究中的表面网格进行自动标志点提取。经主成分分析降维后，所得形状变量用于训练带正则化的逻辑回归模型。主要结局指标为曲线下面积（Area Under the Curve, AUC）、敏感度、特异度和平衡准确率，以估计人工智能筛查模型的性能指标。该模型在未见过的测试数据集上显示出高判别能力（AUC = 0.926；95% CI：0.816–1.000）。当仅由训练集得出的分类阈值应用于测试集时，敏感度为 100%，特异度为 14.3%，平衡准确率为 57.1%。与深度学习模型相比，该方法提供了基于解剖标志点的可解释框架，且不需要大型数据集或大量计算资源。研究结果支持进一步研究躯干表面形态作为 AIS 检测判别信息的来源。在临床筛查应用之前，需要在更大、更具代表性的人群中进行外部验证。

title: Lung cancer multi-subtype classification via soft-voting ensemble architecture.
zh_title: 软投票集成架构用于肺癌多亚型分类
summary: 用EfficientNet-B3、ConvNeXt-Tiny与DenseNet-121的软投票集成分类肺癌亚型，在1.85万张公开CT-PET图像上报告准确率0.9865。
key_points: 三骨干网络仅对类别概率做平均集成
公开数据集含18500张CT-PET图像
准确率与F1均为0.9865，并报告各类召回
reason: 公开数据集回顾性研究，方法为现成骨干集成，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [Network (Bristol, England)] Lung cancer is a highly heterogeneous malignant tumour, and accurate classification of its subtypes is relevant to personalized treatment planning. However, overlapping imaging appearances and severe class imbalance make multi-subtype classification challenging. To address this problem, we propose a soft-voting ensemble of EfficientNet-B3, ConvNeXt-Tiny, and DenseNet-121. The three independently optimized backbones were selected for their complementary architectural characteristics and the framework does not explicitly disentangle or fuse their feature representations. Instead, it averages their class-probability outputs at inference. Experiments on a public dataset containing 18,500 CT-PET images show that the ensemble achieves an accuracy of 0.9865 and an F1 score of 0.9865. The class-wise recalls for adenocarcinoma, large cell carcinoma, small cell carcinoma, and squamous cell carcinoma are 99.55%, 100.00%, 96.17%, and 98.20%, respectively. These retrospective image-level results support further investigation of the framework as a potential radiologist-assistance tool.
zh_abstract: [Network (Bristol, England)] 肺癌是一种高度异质性恶性肿瘤，其亚型的准确分类与个性化治疗计划相关。然而，重叠的影像表现和严重的类别不平衡使多亚型分类具有挑战性。为解决此问题，我们提出一种由 EfficientNet-B3、ConvNeXt-Tiny 和 DenseNet-121 组成的软投票集成。选择三个独立优化的骨干网络是因其互补的架构特征，且该框架并未显式解缠或融合其特征表示。相反，它在推理时平均其类别概率输出。在包含 18,500 张 CT-PET 图像的公开数据集上的实验表明，该集成达到 0.9865 的准确率和 0.9865 的 F1 分数。腺癌、大细胞癌、小细胞癌和鳞状细胞癌的类别召回率分别为 99.55%、100.00%、96.17% 和 98.20%。这些回顾性图像层面结果支持进一步研究该框架作为潜在放射科医师辅助工具。

title: Thermodynamically Guided CRISPR Spacer Optimization: Strategy-Dependent Off-Target Trade-Offs.
source: PubMed · Journal of chemical information and modeling
zh_title: 热力学引导的CRISPR间隔序列优化与脱靶权衡
summary: 将SpCas9间隔序列优化建模为约束搜索，比较三种强化学习策略、分数引导搜索与LLM引导搜索。
key_points: 以CRISPRspec特异性加GC与同聚物惩罚为目标
在统一设定下比较5种搜索策略
发现不同策略在脱靶风险上存在权衡
reason: 计算性方法比较研究，未见湿实验或外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of chemical information and modeling] Most CRISPR-Cas9 design tools select guide RNAs (gRNAs) by ranking predefined candidates rather than actively optimizing them. Here we instead formulate SpCas9 spacer refinement as a constrained search problem, in which a limited number of nucleotide substitutions may be introduced outside the PAM-proximal seed region. The search is driven by a thermodynamically grounded objective that combines CRISPRspec-based specificity with penalties for suboptimal GC content and long homopolymer runs. Within this single setting we compare five search strategies: three reinforcement-learning (RL) policies, which are Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), Quantile-Regression Deep Q-Network (QR-DQN), and Rainbow Deep Q-Network (Rainbow DQN), together with a nonlearning score-guided search and a prompt-guided large language model (LLM). All five share the same objective, mutable positions, substitution budget, and evaluation protocol, so that only the search strategy differs. On 100 held-out IGF2R guides from a gene and chromosome excluded from training, every strategy significantly reduced the predicted off-target burden (38.6-78.3%) and improved independent specificity metrics without degrading on-target scores. The strategies nevertheless differed sharply in per-guide safety: the LLM achieved the largest aggregate reduction but introduced new off-target sites into 38% of guides that were initially free of them, whereas PPO, an on-policy RL algorithm, retained a strong gain with the lowest regression rate of 15%. These results show that the thermodynamic objective supplies a robust common optimization signal, while the choice of search strategy governs the trade-off between aggregate improvement and regression of already-favorable guides.
zh_abstract: [Journal of chemical information and modeling] 大多数 CRISPR-Cas9 设计工具通过对预定义候选进行排序来选择向导 RNA（gRNA），而不是主动优化它们。在此，我们转而将 SpCas9 间隔序列（spacer）的优化表述为一个约束搜索问题，其中可在 PAM 近端种子区（PAM-proximal seed region）之外引入有限数量的核苷酸替换。该搜索由一个热力学基础的目标函数驱动，该目标函数将基于 CRISPRspec 的特异性与对次优 GC 含量和长同聚物连续序列的惩罚相结合。在这一单一设定中，我们比较了五种搜索策略：三种强化学习（RL）策略，即近端策略优化（PPO）、分位数回归深度 Q 网络（QR-DQN）和 Rainbow 深度 Q 网络（Rainbow DQN），以及一种非学习型评分引导搜索和一种提示引导的大语言模型（LLM）。五者共享相同的目标函数、可突变位置、替换预算和评估方案，因此仅搜索策略不同。在来自一个被排除于训练之外的基因和染色体的 100 条留出 IGF2R 向导 RNA 上，每种策略都显著降低了预测脱靶负荷（38.6–78.3%），并改善了独立的特异性指标，同时未降低在靶评分。然而，各策略在逐向导 RNA 安全性方面差异显著：LLM 取得了最大的总体降幅，但在最初无脱靶位点的向导 RNA 中，有 38% 被引入了新的脱靶位点；而 PPO（一种同策略 RL 算法）在保持强劲增益的同时，回归率最低，为 15%。这些结果表明，热力学目标函数提供了稳健的共同优化信号，而搜索策略的选择决定了总体改善与原本有利向导 RNA 回归之间的权衡。

title: The effectiveness of AI-based cognitive behavioral therapy chatbots for anxiety and depression symptoms: a systematic review and meta-analysis.

abstract: [Frontiers in public health] AI chatbots are increasingly being used to provide accessible psychological support. However, the effectiveness of chatbot-delivered cognitive behavioral therapy for anxiety and depressive symptoms remains uncertain. This study aimed to evaluate the effects of artificial intelligence chatbot-based cognitive behavioral therapy on anxiety and depressive symptoms. A systematic search of PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, PsycINFO, Cochrane Library, CNKI, VIP, Wanfang, and CBM databases was conducted from their inception to July 8th, 2025. Updated search on August 25, 2026. Meta-analysis was conducted using Stata version 18.0 and RevMan version 5.4. The ES for the treatment effect was calculated using the SMD. Ten studies involving a total of 1,301 participants. The results of the meta-analysis showed that the CBT of AI chatbots could significantly improve depressive symptoms at the end of the intervention (d = -0.40, 95% CI: -0.62 ~ -0.17, P = 0.0005). In contrast, the intervention did not significantly improve anxiety symptoms (d = -0.029, 95% CI: -0.145 ~ 0.087, P = 0.623), with no substantial heterogeneity detected (I 2= 0%). The subgroup analysis for depressive symptoms indicated significant effects were observed in participant age stratification, intervention Duration, and Control group intervention. However, some subgroup estimates were based on a small number of studies, so the data should be interpreted with caution. This meta-analysis emphasizes that AI-based chatbots for CBT may have great potential in contributing to the alleviation of depressive symptoms. Given the small number of included studies and the high heterogeneity, the results should be interpreted with caution. More high-quality RCTs are needed in the future to further validate these findings and explore their long-term benefits. https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251089835.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in public health] 人工智能聊天机器人正越来越多地用于提供可及的心理支持。然而，聊天机器人递送的认知行为疗法对焦虑和抑郁症状的有效性仍不确定。本研究旨在评估基于人工智能聊天机器人的认知行为疗法对焦虑和抑郁症状的影响。对PubMed、Embase、Web of Science、PsycINFO、Cochrane Library、CNKI、VIP、Wanfang和CBM数据库从建库至2025年7月8日进行了系统检索。于2026年8月25日进行了更新检索。使用Stata 18.0版和RevMan 5.4版进行Meta分析。治疗效应的效应量（ES）采用标准化均数差（SMD）计算。共纳入10项研究，涉及总计1,301名参与者。Meta分析结果显示，AI聊天机器人的CBT在干预结束时能显著改善抑郁症状（d = -0.40，95% CI：-0.62 ~ -0.17，P = 0.0005）。相比之下，该干预未显著改善焦虑症状（d = -0.029，95% CI：-0.145 ~ 0.087，P = 0.623），未检测到显著异质性（I² = 0%）。抑郁症状的亚组分析表明，在参与者年龄分层、干预时长和对照组干预中观察到显著效应。然而，部分亚组估计基于少量研究，因此应谨慎解释数据。本Meta分析强调，用于CBT的基于AI的聊天机器人可能在帮助缓解抑郁症状方面具有很大潜力。鉴于纳入研究数量少且异质性高，结果应谨慎解释。未来需要更多高质量RCT进一步验证这些发现并探索其长期获益。https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251089835.

title: Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Natural Product Pharmacology: From Molecular Discovery to Precision Therapeutics.
zh_title: AI赋能天然产物药理学：从分子发现到精准治疗
summary: 同行评审综述，讨论AI与系统药理学在天然产物分子筛选、靶点优选与精准治疗中的应用。
key_points: 天然产物多组分多靶点及暴露变异带来药理学表征难题

abstract: [Pharmacological research] The use of natural products as a chemically diverse source of bioactive molecules for drug development has been well established; however, their multicomponent and multitarget nature, uncertain target causality, variable in vivo exposure, and heterogeneous responses to therapy make them challenging to characterize pharmacologically and translate into clinical practice. Systems pharmacology, together with artificial intelligence (AI), provides new approaches for molecular screening, target prioritization, integration of multidimensional data, and development of precision therapeutics. Osteoarthritis (OA), a heterogeneous whole-joint disease characterized by inflammation, oxidative stress, metabolic dysfunction, and tissue remodeling, serves as a representative model for evaluating such approaches. Network pharmacology can be used to organize relationships among natural product constituents, disease-related targets, and signaling pathways. AI can further assist with activity prediction, compound and target prioritization, multi-omics integration, and patient stratification. Studies combining network pharmacology, molecular docking, deep-learning-based affinity prediction, and experimental validation to narrow the list of potential candidate constituents and targets demonstrate the utility of computational methods in candidate prioritization. This article describes the transition of natural product pharmacology from empirical discovery and systems-based analysis to AI-enabled molecular discovery, mechanistic interpretation, pharmacokinetic assessment, and precision therapeutics. Although computational approaches may facilitate the identification and prioritization of biologically active constituents and targets, they remain limited by uncertainty regarding causality, inadequate in vivo exposure, model dependence, and insufficient clinical evidence. Future studies should focus on precise active-compound identification, direct target validation, systematic pharmacokinetic assessment, and high-quality clinical research to enhance the reliability and translational value of AI-enabled natural product pharmacology.
zh_abstract: [Pharmacological research] 天然产物作为药物开发中化学多样性丰富的生物活性分子来源，其应用已得到充分确立；然而，其多组分和多靶点特性、靶点因果关系的不确定性、体内暴露的变异性以及对治疗反应的异质性，使其在药理学表征和临床转化方面面临挑战。系统药理学与人工智能（AI）一起，为分子筛选、靶点优先级排序、多维数据整合和精准治疗开发提供了新方法。骨关节炎（OA）是一种以炎症、氧化应激、代谢功能障碍和组织重塑为特征的异质性全关节疾病，可作为评估此类方法的代表性模型。网络药理学可用于整理天然产物成分、疾病相关靶点和信号通路之间的关系。AI可进一步辅助活性预测、化合物和靶点优先级排序、多组学整合以及患者分层。结合网络药理学、分子对接、基于深度学习的亲和力预测和实验验证以缩小潜在候选成分和靶点清单的研究，证明了计算方法在候选物优先级排序中的效用。本文描述天然产物药理学从经验发现和基于系统的分析向AI赋能的分子发现、机制阐释、药代动力学评估和精准治疗的转变。尽管计算方法可能有助于生物活性成分和靶点的识别与优先级排序，但它们仍受限于因果关系的不确定性、体内暴露不足、模型依赖性以及临床证据不充分。未来研究应聚焦于精确的活性化合物识别、直接靶点验证、系统药代动力学评估和高质量临床研究，以提高AI赋能天然产物药理学的可靠性和转化价值。

title: The arc of uncertainty across clinicians' interactions with AI.
zh_title: 临床医生与AI互动中的不确定性链条
summary: 同行评审观点文章，梳理医生使用大模型推理时从选择工具到采纳输出的多阶段风险。
key_points: LLM在临床推理中已有较强表现但存在不易察觉的管理错误
流程分为是否使用、如何交互、如何解读与是否行动
各阶段风险不同，如何整合入实践并改善结局仍待解
reason: 观点类文章无新数据，按综述观点档上限内取4分
abstract: [Discover artificial intelligence] Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used in various clinical settings to support clinical reasoning and decision-making. Although they have demonstrated strong performance on medical knowledge and reasoning tasks, and early studies suggest potential to reduce medical errors, emerging evidence also highlights important safety concerns, including clinically significant management errors in outputs that may not be readily apparent to users. How these tools can be integrated into clinical practice to consistently lead to improved patient outcomes remains an open question. AI-assisted reasoning unfolds across a sequence of decisions: whether to use AI for the clinical question, how to engage with the tool, how to interpret its output, and whether to act. Each stage in this sequence introduces distinct risks, including inappropriate tool selection, incomplete or biased inputs, overconfidence in fluent responses, and failure to recognize error or appreciate nuance. These risks are further shaped by the same clinician factors that generally affect clinical reasoning such as experience, workload, and uncertainty management. Viewing the AI-clinician interaction as a process rather than a single moment highlights several key points of vulnerability but also opportunities for training. Ultimately, the safe use of AI may depend less on the quality of the model and more on the clinician's ability to recognize when its outputs should be questioned, verified, or set aside.
zh_abstract: [Discover artificial intelligence] 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地用于各种临床场景，以支持临床推理和决策。尽管它们已在医学知识和推理任务上表现出强大性能，且早期研究提示其有减少医疗错误的潜力，但新出现的证据也凸显了重要的安全性担忧，包括输出中可能不易被用户察觉的具有临床意义的处置错误。如何将这些工具整合到临床实践中以持续改善患者结局仍是一个未解问题。AI辅助推理沿一系列决策展开：是否针对该临床问题使用AI、如何与工具交互、如何解读其输出以及是否采取行动。该序列中的每个阶段都会引入不同风险，包括工具选择不当、输入不完整或有偏、对流畅回答过度自信，以及未能识别错误或领会细微差别。这些风险还受到通常影响临床推理的同一批临床医生因素进一步塑造，如经验、工作负荷和不确定性管理。将AI-临床医生互动视为一个过程而非单一时刻，凸显了若干关键脆弱点，也凸显了培训机会。最终，AI的安全使用可能较少取决于模型质量，而更多取决于临床医生识别其输出何时应被质疑、核实或搁置的能力。

title: Machine Learning-Assisted Nanozymes: From Design to Application.

abstract: [Advanced healthcare materials] Nanozymes are synthetic nanomaterials engineered to mimic the catalytic functions of natural enzymes, characterized by facile synthesis, ease of surface modification, low cost, and high stability, and they have been widely applied in various fields. However, the rational design and synthesis of nanozymes remain complex, and their activity is challenging to predict. In recent years, the advent of machine learning (ML) has shown great promise in addressing these issues. This review first systematically elucidates the fundamental principles and common algorithms of ML, followed by an exploration of its role in nanozyme research, with a focused discussion on the synergistic applications of ML and nanozymes in the biomedical field. Finally, this review analyzes the key challenges faced by researchers in applying ML to nanozyme studies as well as the corresponding solutions and provides an outlook on future development directions. Furthermore, given the relatively limited reports on ML-assisted nanozyme research to date, this study aims to deepen the understanding of nanozymes and more effectively advance nanozyme research toward the era of artificial intelligence.
zh_abstract: [Advanced Healthcare Materials] 纳米酶（nanozymes）是经过工程化设计以模拟天然酶催化功能的合成纳米材料，具有合成简便、易于表面修饰、成本低和稳定性高等特点，并已广泛应用于各个领域。然而，纳米酶的理性设计与合成仍然复杂，其活性也难以预测。近年来，机器学习（ML）的出现为解决这些问题展现出巨大前景。本综述首先系统阐述 ML 的基本原理和常用算法，随后探讨其在纳米酶研究中的作用，重点讨论 ML 与纳米酶在生物医学领域的协同应用。最后，本综述分析研究人员在将 ML 应用于纳米酶研究时面临的关键挑战及相应解决方案，并对未来发展方向作出展望。此外，鉴于迄今为止关于 ML 辅助纳米酶研究的报道相对有限，本研究旨在加深对纳米酶的理解，并更有效地推动纳米酶研究迈向人工智能时代。

title: Development of a fully AI-based three-dimensional workflow for personalized target set-ups in orthodontics: First results.

abstract: [International orthodontics] To present a fully automated artificial intelligence (AI) workflow to generate personalized orthodontic target set-ups and compare the quality of the occlusal outcome with manual set-ups, using the American Board of Orthodontics Model Grading System (ABO MGS). The AI workflow takes an intraoral scan and performs tooth segmentation, landmark detection, tooth completion, and tooth alignment to generate a 3D-printable personalized set-up without human intervention. The occlusal outcome was evaluated on twenty non-extraction full jaw cases treated with customized fixed appliances by comparing the AI set-ups to manual set-ups made by experienced laboratory technicians. Both set-up series were scored with the ABO MGS for alignment and rotations, marginal ridges, buccolingual inclination, overjet, occlusal contacts, occlusal relationships, and interproximal contacts. The 'alignment and rotations' category was additionally analysed separately for the anterior (canine to canine) and posterior (premolars to second molars) segments. Paired comparisons used the two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test (α=0.05). Based on the total ABO MGS scores, the AI set-ups (mean: 14.95) and manual set-ups (mean: 12.20) showed high-quality occlusal outcomes, which were both far below the ABO passing score. AI set-ups showed significantly more penalty points for alignment and rotations (median: 8 vs. 5; P<0.001). This difference was confined to the posterior segments; anterior alignment was near-ideal for both methods. Other categories did not differ significantly (P=0.082-0.886). For the first time, a fully automated AI-based 3D workflow generated personalized orthodontic target set-ups for non-extraction cases with a clinically acceptable, high-quality occlusal outcome, in approximately four minutes. Posterior alignment remains the only shortcoming of the AI set-ups and is the obvious target for further algorithm refinement or brief manual correction.
zh_abstract: [International orthodontics] 旨在提出一种全自动人工智能（AI）工作流程，以生成个性化正畸目标设置（set-ups），并使用美国正畸委员会模型评分系统（ABO MGS）将咬合结果质量与手动设置进行比较。该 AI 工作流程接收口内扫描，执行牙齿分割、标志点检测、牙齿补全和牙齿排列，从而在无人工干预的情况下生成可 3D 打印的个性化设置。咬合结果在 20 例接受定制固定矫治器治疗的非拔牙全牙弓病例上评估，通过将 AI 设置与由经验丰富的实验室技师制作的手动设置进行比较。两套设置均使用 ABO MGS 对排列与旋转、边缘嵴、颊舌向倾斜、覆盖、咬合接触、咬合关系和邻面接触进行评分。“排列与旋转”类别还分别对前段（尖牙至尖牙）和后段（前磨牙至第二磨牙）进行了分析。配对比较使用双侧 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验（α=0.05）。基于 ABO MGS 总分，AI 设置（均值：14.95）和手动设置（均值：12.20）均显示出高质量咬合结果，二者均远低于 ABO 通过分数。AI 设置在排列与旋转方面显示出显著更多的罚分（中位数：8 对 5；P<0.001）。这一差异仅限于后段；两种方法的前段排列均接近理想。其他类别无显著差异（P=0.082–0.886）。首次，一个基于 AI 的全自动 3D 工作流程在约四分钟内为非拔牙病例生成了个性化正畸目标设置，并具有临床可接受的高质量咬合结果。后段排列仍是 AI 设置唯一的不足，也是进一步算法改进或简短手动校正的明显目标。

title: rendehR: a cohort-first, provenance-aware, agentic-ready pipeline for harmonizing multi-source electronic health records

abstract: Objective: Public electronic health record (EHR) databases differ in schema, identifiers, coding systems, units, and event structure, making disease-specific studies across multiple sources difficult to construct and audit. We developed rendehR, a computational pipeline and R package for cohort-centered extraction and harmonization of multi-source EHR data. Materials and Methods: rendehR treats cohort definition as an explicit executable component of dataset construction. Cohorts can be defined using diagnosis codes, identifiers, R callbacks, or source-specific SQL. After cohort selection, linked source tables are restricted to the selected population and can be retained as cohort-specific Parquet datasets or loaded into a persistent database. Clinical concepts are defined using source-aware mappings, generated, or curated SQL and are harmonized into flat, time-series, and duration representations. Configuration, executable SQL, cohort metadata, concept-origin metadata, and source-level values are retained to support inspection and traceability. In the current version rendehR provides interactive R assistant wizards for workflow configuration, a Shiny application for patient-level data visualization, three agent skills for AI-assisted workflow execution and extension, and an MCP server exposing nine read-only tools for AI-assisted configuration, concept discovery, and cohort exploration. The current implementation supports MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV, and eICU-CRD. We demonstrate rendehR on a reference cohort of spinal cord injury and disease (SCID). Results: Using the reference cohort, rendehR identified 4,320, 39,850, and 2,343 qualifying hospital admissions in MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV, and eICU-CRD, respectively. Patient-level extraction expanded these cohorts to 5,725, 104,988, and 2,823 hospital admissions, with 5,983, 17,405, and 3,441 associated ICU stays, respectively. Applying the more complex Sepsis-3 case identification, rendehR identified and extracted 34,460, 41,296, and 47,035 qualifying ICU stays across the same databases, respectively. The current concept library includes 22 flat, 123 time-series, and 75 duration harmonized concepts. Conclusion: rendehR provides a cohort-centered framework for constructing disease-specific datasets from multiple heterogeneous HER sources while preserving the source-specific logic used to define cohorts and clinical concepts. The package supports reusable cohort artifacts, inspectable SQL-based concept construction, harm
zh_abstract: 【目的】公共电子健康记录（EHR）数据库在模式、标识符、编码系统、单位和事件结构方面存在差异，使得跨多个来源的疾病特异性研究难以构建和审计。我们开发了 rendehR，这是一个以队列为中心、用于多源 EHR 数据提取和协调的计算流程和 R 包。【材料与方法】rendehR 将队列定义视为数据集构建中明确的可执行组件。可使用诊断代码、标识符、R 回调或来源特定 SQL 来定义队列。队列选择后，关联的源表被限制为所选人群，并可保留为队列特定的 Parquet 数据集或加载到持久数据库中。临床概念使用来源感知映射、生成或整理的 SQL 定义，并被协调为扁平、时间序列和持续时间表示。配置、可执行 SQL、队列元数据、概念来源元数据和来源层面值均被保留，以支持检查与可追溯性。在当前版本中，rendehR 提供用于工作流配置的交互式 R 助手向导、用于患者层面数据可视化的 Shiny 应用程序、三项用于 AI 辅助工作流执行与扩展的 agent 技能，以及一个 MCP 服务器，公开九个只读工具用于 AI 辅助配置、概念发现和队列探索。当前实现支持 MIMIC-III、MIMIC-IV 和 eICU-CRD。我们在脊髓损伤和疾病（SCID）的参考队列上展示了 rendehR。【结果】使用参考队列，rendehR 在 MIMIC-III、MIMIC-IV 和 eICU-CRD 中分别识别出 4,320、39,850 和 2,343 次符合条件的住院。患者层面提取将这些队列分别扩展至 5,725、104,988 和 2,823 次住院，并分别关联 5,983、17,405 和 3,441 次 ICU 住院。应用更复杂的 Sepsis-3 病例识别，rendehR 在相同数据库中分别识别并提取了 34,460、41,296 和 47,035 次符合条件的 ICU 住院。当前概念库包括 22 个扁平、123 个时间序列和 75 个持续时间协调概念。【结论】rendehR 提供了一个以队列为中心的框架，用于从多个异质性 HER 来源构建疾病特异性数据集，同时保留用于定义队列和临床概念的来源特定逻辑。该包支持可复用的队列产物、可检查的基于 SQL 的概念构建，以及 harm

title: Machine Learning-based Transcriptomic Data Analysis of Long COVID Patients: Generating Hypotheses for Molecular Signatures
zh_title: 机器学习分析长新冠转录组数据，生成分子特征假设
summary: 整合六个 RNA-seq 数据集，用监督机器学习结合 SHAP 识别长新冠相关分子特征，并提出潜在药物重定位线索。
key_points: 整合六个新冠康复与长新冠队列转录组数据
留一批次交叉验证评估模型，SHAP 识别特征
结合通路富集与蛋白互作提出候选药物
reason: 多数据集整合与留一批次验证，但为预印本、无前瞻外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Introduction: Long COVID (LC) remains a global public-health challenge, affecting an estimated 10-30% of COVID-19-survivors. Machine learning (ML) can help identify molecular features associated with LC. Human ion channels (HICs), that regulate immune-cell signaling and cellular homeostasis, may contribute to LC-associated processes and offer insights into relevant pathways and potential drug-repurposing candidates. Methodology: RNA-seq data from COVID-19-recovered and LC patients across six datasets were integrated, preprocessed, and corrected for batch effects. Supervised ML models were evaluated using leave-one-batch-out validation, with SHAP identifying features across validation folds. Functional enrichment, host-host and host-viral protein-protein interaction analyses were performed, followed by drug interaction analysis of potential HICs within the resulting interactome. Results: A support vector classifier with an RBF kernel achieved a mean-AUC of 0.664 across six validation folds. SHAP analysis of the three selected folds (AUC = 0.722, 0.836, and 0.817) identified 225, 153, and 241 genes, respectively. Functional enrichment highlighted pathways including histidine metabolism and TNF signaling. Among the 613 genes identified across these folds, 9 were HICs and 39 were immune signaling-related genes (ISGs), whose protein-protein interaction analysis revealed a pharmacologically relevant interactome. Furthermore, four HICs including CLCN3, KCNQ3, RYR1, and ZACN interacted with 30 approved drugs. Conclusion: ML-based analysis of integrated RNA-seq data identified HICs and ISGs associated with LC, while functional enrichment and PPI analyses provided insights into their potential biological relevance. Drug interaction analysis further highlighted candidate HIC-targeting drugs for future investigation in LC management. This computational framework provides preliminary, hypothesis-generating insights to guide future research.
zh_abstract: 【背景】长新冠（LC）仍是全球公共卫生挑战，估计影响10-30%的COVID-19幸存者。机器学习（ML）有助于识别与LC相关的分子特征。人类离子通道（HIC）调节免疫细胞信号传导和细胞稳态，可能参与LC相关过程，并为相关通路及潜在药物重定位候选物提供见解。【方法】整合了来自六个数据集的COVID-19康复者和LC患者的RNA-seq数据，进行预处理并校正批次效应。使用留一批次交叉验证评估监督ML模型，并由SHAP在验证折中识别特征。进行了功能富集、宿主-宿主和宿主-病毒蛋白-蛋白相互作用分析，随后对所得相互作用组中潜在HIC进行药物相互作用分析。【结果】带RBF核的支持向量分类器在六个验证折中达到平均AUC 0.664。对所选三个折（AUC=0.722、0.836和0.817）的SHAP分析分别识别出225、153和241个基因。功能富集突出了包括组氨酸代谢和TNF信号传导在内的通路。在这些折共识别出的613个基因中，9个为HIC，39个为免疫信号相关基因（ISG），其蛋白-蛋白相互作用分析揭示了一个药理学相关的相互作用组。此外，包括CLCN3、KCNQ3、RYR1和ZACN在内的四个HIC与30种已批准药物发生相互作用。【结论】基于ML的整合RNA-seq数据分析识别出与LC相关的HIC和ISG，功能富集和PPI分析为其潜在生物学相关性提供了见解。药物相互作用分析进一步突出了候选HIC靶向药物，供未来在LC管理中研究。该计算框架提供了初步的、产生假设的见解，以指导未来研究。

title: Laya-IsoToken: Day-One Clinical Codebook Switching via Closed-Form Operator Compilation
zh_title: Laya-IsoToken：无需目标标注的临床编码本切换
summary: 预印本提出将临床文本读取与冻结多语言概念空间解耦，借助公开目标编码描述实现新编码本首日切换。
key_points: 针对ICD、MS-DRG等编码本更新场景
无需目标编码标注病历即可切换
无可训练逐码分类参数，减少重标注
以公开编码描述做闭式映射
reason: 方法有新意但为预印本、细节截断，证据有限，值得一看档
abstract: Healthcare systems periodically revise diagnostic and procedural classifications (ICD-9 to ICD-10/11), update hospital reimbursement groupers (MS-DRG), and deploy clinical coding across languages. Supervised coding networks bind clinical text encoders to fixed per-code classifier weights, forcing hospitals to re-annotate tens of thousands of records before switching codebooks, whereas standalone large language models incur high latency and hallucinate invalid codes. Here we show that day-one clinical codebook switching becomes feasible without target-labeled notes when local clinical evidence reading is decoupled from a strictly frozen multilingual concept space. Laya-IsoToken trains a clinical span reader once on source records with zero per-code classifier parameters, separating text evidence from historical disease prevalence. Given only public target code descriptions, closed-form matrix compilation aligns distributional shifts, compensates for paraphrased definitions, and deduplicates sibling codes in under three seconds, while a pre-deployment geometric residual routes unfamiliar concepts to offline language model verification. Across 32,804 MIMIC-IV ICD-9 discharges, Laya-IsoToken matches published supervised baselines (62.6% Micro-F1) while reducing active calibration error by 32%. Switched with zero target training notes to 13,783 unseen-patient ICD-10 discharges, MS-DRG groups, and multilingual cohorts, it outperforms biomedical dense retrievers, semantic crosswalks (+5.4 F1 points on ICD-10, paired $d_z = 0.49$, $p < 0.001$), and official US CMS equivalence mappings (+3.5 points, $p < 0.001$) at 9.4 ms per admission. Pairing this reader with an offline 31B verifier across 1,000 full discharge summaries lifts zero-training ICD-10 coding to 40.6% Micro-F1 (57.0% category F1, $d_z = 0.66$, $p < 0.001$) with 0.0% invalid code hallucinations.
zh_abstract: 医疗系统会定期修订诊断与操作分类（ICD-9 到 ICD-10/11）、更新医院支付分组器（MS-DRG），并跨语言部署临床编码。监督式编码网络将临床文本编码器绑定到固定的每代码分类器权重，迫使医院在切换代码本前重新标注数万份记录；而独立的大语言模型则延迟高，并会幻觉出无效代码。在此我们表明，当局部临床证据读取与严格冻结的多语言概念空间解耦时，无需目标标注病历即可实现首日临床代码本切换。Laya-IsoToken 在源记录上一次性训练临床跨度读取器，每代码分类器参数为零，从而将文本证据与历史疾病患病率分离。仅给定公开的目标代码描述，闭式矩阵编译可在三秒内对齐分布偏移、补偿改写定义并对兄弟代码去重，而部署前几何残差会将不熟悉的概念路由至离线语言模型验证。在 32,804 例 MIMIC-IV ICD-9 出院记录中，Laya-IsoToken 达到已发表监督基线水平（62.6% Micro-F1），同时将主动校准误差降低 32%。在零目标训练标注下切换至 13,783 例未见患者的 ICD-10 出院记录、MS-DRG 分组和多语言队列时，其性能优于生物医学稠密检索器、语义交叉映射（在 ICD-10 上 +5.4 F1 点，配对 $d_z = 0.49$，$p < 0.001$）以及美国 CMS 官方等价映射（+3.5 点，$p < 0.001$），每次入院耗时 9.4 ms。将该读取器与离线 31B 验证器配对，在 1,000 份完整出院小结上，将零训练 ICD-10 编码提升至 40.6% Micro-F1（57.0% 类别 F1，$d_z = 0.66$，$p < 0.001$），且无效代码幻觉为 0.0%。

title: When Should We Trust Medical Image Models? Evaluating Confidence Reliability under Cross-Dataset Shift
zh_title: 跨数据集迁移下医学影像模型置信度可靠性评估
summary: 在CheXpert训练、MIMIC-CXR外部测试胸片模型，考察置信度校准与预测性能的跨院迁移退化。
key_points: ResNet-50与DenseNet-121，五种实验设置
关注气胸与胸腔积液两类标签
用ECE、Brier分数与错误预测平均置信度评估
并检验后处理温度缩放的校准效果
reason: 有跨数据集外部验证与校准分析，但属预印本、仅两类任务，属值得一看档
abstract: Deep learning models for chest X-ray analysis often achieve strong performance on benchmark datasets, but their reliability under cross-dataset deployment remains unclear. In clinical practice, models trained in one hospital system may be applied to data from another, where distributional and labeling differences can affect both prediction accuracy and model confidence. We conduct a controlled empirical study of model confidence under cross-dataset transfer. We train ResNet-50 and DenseNet-121 on CheXpert and evaluate them on MIMIC-CXR across five experimental settings, focusing on Pneumothorax and Pleural Effusion. We measure predictive performance using AUC and confidence reliability using Expected Calibration Error (ECE), Brier score, and average confidence on incorrect predictions, all reported with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. We further evaluate post-hoc temperature scaling fit on the source validation set and use Grad-CAM to examine the mechanism behind cross-domain performance differences. Cross-domain AUC drops 7-13 percentage points, and the best in-domain model is not the best cross-domain model. Source-domain temperature scaling produces marginal ECE changes but systematically increases confidence on incorrect predictions across all four model-pathology combinations. Grad-CAM reveals that DenseNet relies on a concentrated spatial prior that fails to transfer, while ResNet's more distributed attention generalizes better. These findings argue for cross-site validation and safety-specific calibration metrics in medical AI evaluation.
zh_abstract: 用于胸部X线分析的深度学习模型通常在基准数据集上取得很强性能，但其在跨数据集部署下的可靠性仍不清楚。在临床实践中，在一个医院系统中训练的模型可能被应用于另一个系统的数据，其中的分布和标注差异会影响预测准确性和模型置信度。我们开展了一项关于跨数据集迁移下模型置信度的受控实证研究。我们在CheXpert上训练ResNet-50和DenseNet-121，并在五种实验设置下于MIMIC-CXR上评估它们，聚焦Pneumothorax（气胸）和Pleural Effusion（胸腔积液）。我们使用AUC衡量预测性能，并使用Expected Calibration Error（ECE）、Brier score以及错误预测上的平均置信度衡量置信可靠性，所有指标均报告95% bootstrap置信区间。我们进一步评估在源验证集上拟合的事后温度缩放，并使用Grad-CAM考察跨域性能差异背后的机制。跨域AUC下降7-13个百分点，且最佳的域内模型并非最佳的跨域模型。源域温度缩放仅带来边际ECE变化，但在全部四种模型-病理组合中系统性提高错误预测上的置信度。Grad-CAM显示，DenseNet依赖一种无法迁移的集中空间先验，而ResNet更分散的注意力泛化更好。这些发现支持在医学AI评价中进行跨中心验证并使用安全性特异的校准指标。

title: Integrating CRISPRi perturbation responses and transcription-factor binding priors for regulatory network inference in triple-negative breast cancer
zh_title: 整合CRISPRi扰动与转录因子结合先验推断三阴性乳腺癌调控网络
summary: 预印本提出干预式基因调控网络推断框架，融合单细胞Perturb-seq与ChIP-seq结合先验。
key_points: 使用GSE224986共95678个细胞、11975个sgRNA
引入ENCODE Factorbook物理结合先验
针对819个体细胞突变相关增强子位点
指出共表达推断假发现率超30%的问题
reason: 方法有新意且数据规模可观，但为预印本、无独立外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Triple-Negative Breast Cancer (TNBC) represents an aggressive breast cancer subtype that lacks actionable cell-surface receptors, restricting frontline systemic management to cytotoxic chemotherapy. While recent functional epigenomics shows that TNBC progression is governed by non-coding regulatory remodeling at distal super-enhancers, conventional Gene Regulatory Network (GRN) inference methods rely on observational transcriptomic co-expression, which suffers from technical dropouts and confounding correlations that inflate false discoveries (>30%). Here, we present an interventional network inference framework that integrates large-scale single-cell CRISPR-interference perturbation sequencing (Perturb-seq; GSE224986, 95,678 cells across 11,975 sgRNAs) with ENCODE Factorbook ChIP-seq physical transcription factor binding priors across 819 somatic mutation-associated enhancer loci in human TNBC (MDA-MB-231). Our pipeline reconstructed a tripartite network yielding 5,935 physical TF-enhancer edges, 383,757 functional enhancer-gene edges, and 542,760 unique TF-target gene functional pairs across 372 active enhancers. Topological centrality prioritized master transcriptional drivers governing TNBC oncogenic signaling, including CTCF, POLR2A, EP300, JUND, MYC, and FOS, which regulate Hallmark programs for Epithelial-Mesenchymal Transition (p = 1.2 x 10-9) and cell cycle progression. Explainable machine learning (SHAP TreeExplainer) revealed non-linear, thresholded transactivation dynamics for AP-1 and MYC. Quantitative benchmarking against held-out CRISPRi ground truth demonstrated strong discriminatory accuracy (AUROC = 0.8999, AUPRC = 0.8745, Precision = 90.13%, FDR = 9.87%), substantially outperforming GENIE3 (AUPRC = 0.6323, FDR = 35.73%) and co-expression correlation (AUPRC = 0.6814). In silico-simulated driver feature silencing correlated with experimental responses (R2 = 0.473, p < 10-122), and master driver signatures significantly stratified overall survival in the METABRIC (n = 320) and TCGA-BRCA (n = 160; p [≤] 0.019) cohorts. Finally, in silico perturbation modeling indicated that multi-target epigenetic combinations achieved 93% topological disruption of oncogenic regulatory connectivity, nominating prioritized candidate circuits for experimental validation.
zh_abstract: 三阴性乳腺癌（Triple-Negative Breast Cancer, TNBC）是一种侵袭性乳腺癌亚型，缺乏可靶向的细胞表面受体，使一线全身治疗仅限于细胞毒性化疗。虽然近期功能表观基因组学显示TNBC进展受远端超级增强子处的非编码调控重塑支配，但传统基因调控网络（GRN）推断方法依赖观察性转录组共表达，后者受技术性丢失和混杂相关影响，而这些会使假发现膨胀（>30%）。在此，我们提出一个干预性网络推断框架，该框架将大规模单细胞CRISPR干扰扰动测序（Perturb-seq；GSE224986，涵盖11,975个sgRNA的95,678个细胞）与ENCODE Factorbook ChIP-seq物理转录因子结合先验整合起来，覆盖人TNBC（MDA-MB-231）中819个体细胞突变相关增强子位点。我们的流程重建了一个三分网络，在372个活跃增强子上产生5,935条物理TF-增强子边、383,757条功能性增强子-基因边和542,760个独特TF-靶基因功能配对。拓扑中心性优先选出支配TNBC致癌信号的主转录驱动因子，包括CTCF、POLR2A、EP300、JUND、MYC和FOS，这些因子调控上皮-间质转化（p = 1.2 × 10^-9）和细胞周期进展的Hallmark程序。可解释机器学习（SHAP TreeExplainer）揭示了AP-1和MYC的非线性、阈值化反式激活动态。针对留出的CRISPRi真值进行的定量基准测试显示出很强的判别准确性（AUROC = 0.8999，AUPRC = 0.8745，Precision = 90.13%，FDR = 9.87%），显著优于GENIE3（AUPRC = 0.6323，FDR = 35.73%）和共表达相关（AUPRC = 0.6814）。计算机模拟的驱动特征沉默与实验反应相关（R2 = 0.473，p < 10^-122），并且主驱动特征在METABRIC（n = 320）和TCGA-BRCA（n = 160；p [≤] 0.019）队列中显著分层总生存期。最后，计算机模拟扰动建模表明，多靶点表观遗传组合实现了致癌调控连接性的93%拓扑破坏，提名了优先候选回路用于实验验证。

title: The unedited acceptance rate: a review-fidelity metric for human-in-the-loop clinical AI
zh_title: 临床AI人机协同中的未编辑接受率指标
summary: 预印本提出可计算的审阅保真度指标，含未编辑接受率UAR，并在单一伦敦门诊部署系统上预先设定12周前瞻分析。
key_points: 定义接受覆盖率、归因完整性与未编辑接受率UAR等指标
在单一私立门诊常规使用的多智能体临床系统上核验指标可实现性
预先设定为期12周的前瞻性分析方案
reason: 提出审阅保真度新指标且已预注册分析，但单中心、尚无结果，属值得一看档。
abstract: Objective. Guidance for large language model (LLM) drafting in clinical care relies on human review, yet review is rarely measured as a control. We aimed to define computable measures of review fidelity, establish which a deployed system can compute, and pre-specify their first analysis. Materials and Methods. For a multi-agent clinical system in routine use at one private London outpatient clinic, we defined acceptance coverage, attribution completeness, the unedited acceptance rate (UAR), a bounded normalized edit distance, availability latency and an unedited fast-approval rate (UFA). We checked each measure against the system's code and database structure at a fixed commit on four approval routes and pre-specified a prospective 12-week analysis. Results. The UAR equals the mass at zero of the edit-distance distribution, and availability latency bounds reading time from above only. Clinical documentation keeps draft and signed text with a recorded signer, so the core measures are computable there. Help-desk edit telemetry is written only when the agent's version has been stored. The WhatsApp agent route records no edit signal, and its approver need not be named. No route records when a draft is opened. Documentation accept events were not written before a change committed on November 16, 2026. Model-generated content, including live voice-agent speech, also reaches patients without approval. No measured values are reported. Discussion. Acceptance alone cannot separate accurate drafts from approval without reading, and three of four routes cannot yet support the family. Conclusion. Review fidelity can be specified as telemetry at the approval event. Validation against missed errors is required.
zh_abstract: 【目的】临床诊疗中用于大语言模型（LLM）起草的指导依赖于人工审核，但审核很少作为控制措施被测量。我们旨在定义可计算的审核保真度指标，确定已部署系统可计算哪些指标，并预先设定其首次分析。【材料与方法】针对伦敦一家私立门诊诊所常规使用的多智能体临床系统，我们定义了接受覆盖率、归因完整性、未编辑接受率（UAR）、有界归一化编辑距离、可用性延迟和未编辑快速批准率（UFA）。我们在固定提交版本上，针对四条批准路径，将每项指标与系统代码和数据库结构进行核对，并预先设定了一项为期12周的前瞻性分析。【结果】UAR等于编辑距离分布在零处的质量，而可用性延迟仅从上方限定阅读时间。临床文档保留草稿和签署文本并记录签署者，因此核心指标可在该处计算。帮助台编辑遥测仅在智能体的版本已被存储时才写入。WhatsApp智能体路径不记录编辑信号，其批准者无需具名。没有路径记录草稿何时被打开。在2026年11月16日提交的一项变更之前，文档接受事件未被写入。模型生成的内容，包括实时语音智能体语音，也未经批准即到达患者。未报告任何测量值。【讨论】仅凭接受率无法区分准确草稿与未阅读即批准，且四条路径中有三条尚不能支持该指标族。【结论】审核保真度可被规定为批准事件处的遥测。需要针对遗漏错误进行验证。

title: A2Holo: Dual-Stream Flow Matching of 3D Structure and a Protein Language Model for Conformational Transition Prediction
zh_title: A2Holo：蛋白构象转变预测
summary: 用双流流匹配结合蛋白质语言模型，从无配体结构预测配体结合构象。
key_points: 将apo到holo预测建模为实验结构间流匹配
移植双流联合注意力到残基对齐的序列与结构
D3PM基准中位Cα RMSD为0.809Å
reason: 新方法在基准上优于随机基线，预印本未提代码，属值得一看档
abstract: Modelling a ligand-bound holo conformation from a ligand-free apo conformation is essential in structure-based drug discovery. We present A2Holo, which casts apo-to-holo prediction as flow matching between two experimental structures rather than generation from noise. It transplants the dual-stream joint attention of in-context image generation to residue-aligned protein language model embeddings and structure. Without ligand conditioning or stochastic sampling, A2Holo's single deterministic trajectory reaches a median C RMSD of 0.809 [A] on the D3PM benchmark, the lowest among existing methods. Its TM-score exceeds even the best of 10 samples from every stochastic baseline on at least 144 of 150 pairs. Beyond performance, we directly measure the transplanted multimodal mechanism itself. Because sequence and structure are residue-aligned, its joint attention can be measured at residue resolution and tested for reproducibility across independently trained model variants. Within the structure stream, the attention a residue receives recovers moving residues better than the attention it emits, and this asymmetry is learned. A2Holo demonstrates a successful multimodal transplant from in-context image generation to protein conformational change, with strong deterministic apo-to-holo prediction. It also provides a quantitative account of how that mechanism organises residue-aligned sequence and structure around the residues that move.
zh_abstract: 从无配体apo构象建模配体结合的holo构象在基于结构的药物发现中至关重要。我们提出A2Holo，它将apo到holo预测视为两个实验结构之间的流匹配，而不是从噪声生成。它将在上下文图像生成中的双流联合注意力移植到残基对齐的蛋白质语言模型嵌入与结构上。无需配体条件或随机采样，A2Holo的单条确定性轨迹在D3PM基准上达到0.809 [A]的中位C RMSD，为现有方法中最低。在150对中的至少144对上，其TM-score甚至超过每个随机基线10个样本中的最佳者。除性能外，我们直接测量移植的多模态机制本身。由于序列和结构是残基对齐的，其联合注意力可以在残基分辨率上测量，并在独立训练的模型变体间检验可重复性。在结构流内，一个残基接收到的注意力比其发出的注意力更能恢复运动残基，且这种不对称是学习到的。A2Holo展示了从上下文图像生成到蛋白质构象变化的多模态移植成功，并具有强确定性apo到holo预测。它还定量说明了该机制如何围绕发生运动的残基组织残基对齐的序列与结构。

title: Decompose and Describe: Narrowing the Diagnosis-to-Report Gap in 3D CT Report Generation
zh_title: 分解与描述：缩小3D CT报告生成的诊断-报告差距
summary: 预印本提出DeCAD，将3D CT报告生成分解为诊断、区域文本与区域视觉任务，以缩小诊断到报告的差距。
key_points: 五款MedVLMs诊断VQA宏F1高于报告生成
常规报告适配未消除诊断-报告差距
DeCAD逐级分解诊断、区域文本与视觉任务
reason: 预印本新方法，有多模型对比但无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Automated 3D CT report generation could support radiology workflows, yet medical vision-language models (MedVLMs) often omit diagnostic findings from generated reports. We ask whether the diagnostic ability of these models carries over to free-form reporting. Across five MedVLMs, diagnostic VQA achieves higher macro-F1 than reports generated from the same CT studies and evaluated on the same disease categories. We call this task-dependent discrepancy the diagnosis-to-report gap. Conventional Report Adaptation improves reporting for most models but does not close the gap. To investigate and narrow it, we introduce DeCAD (Decompose CT Analysis and Describe), which progressively decomposes CT report generation at diagnostic, regional textual, and regional visual levels. The model identifies positive findings before writing a report, organizes diagnosis and description into regional tasks, and restricts each task to visual tokens from the corresponding region. Diagnostic and regional textual decomposition improve report-level diagnostic performance across the five MedVLMs, whereas regional visual decomposition provides limited additional gains. In a standard VLM without medical VQA pretraining, the first two levels remain effective; regional visual decomposition also provides further gains with a region-level contrastively pretrained encoder. Full DeCAD achieves state-of-the-art performance on CT-RATE and Merlin.
