abstract: [Frontiers in digital health] Depression and other mental health challenges can affect daily functioning and well-being, while social stigma and limited access to culturally appropriate digital resources may discourage individuals from seeking support. This study presents REWAA, a bilingual mobile application designed to support emotional self-tracking, access to mental health resources, and interaction with mental health professionals in Arabic and English. REWAA was developed as an Android application with separate patient and therapist interfaces. Its features include mood self-tracking, an exploratory AI-based facial-analysis tool, the Bilingual Hybrid Mood Heuristic (BHMH) protocol, an AI-supported conversational tool, mental wellness resources, peer support groups, and therapist communication. The application was evaluated through a user survey involving 200 respondents to assess usability, perceived usefulness, emotional awareness, privacy, and user acceptance. Survey responses indicated generally positive perceptions of REWAA. Most respondents rated the graphical user interface as comfortable and easy to navigate (70%), while 60% reported that the REWAA bot helped them better understand their feelings and provided practical advice. In addition, 55% reported a significant improvement in emotional awareness, and 65% considered the application useful alongside professional therapy. Overall, the findings indicate positive user perceptions of the application's accessibility and integrated support features. REWAA demonstrates the potential of a bilingual digital platform to bring emotional self-tracking, supportive resources, and therapist interaction together in one application. However, the findings primarily reflect user-reported usability and acceptance and do not establish clinical diagnostic accuracy or therapeutic effectiveness. Further evaluation involving appropriate clinical validation and longitudinal follow-up is needed to assess its effectiveness and reliability in real-world mental health settings.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in Digital Health] 抑郁症和其他心理健康挑战会影响日常功能和福祉，而社会污名和文化适宜数字资源获取受限可能使个体不愿寻求支持。本研究介绍REWAA，这是一款双语移动应用程序，旨在以阿拉伯语和英语支持情绪自我追踪、获取心理健康资源以及与心理健康专业人员互动。REWAA是作为Android应用程序开发的，具有独立的患者和治疗师界面。其功能包括情绪自我追踪、探索性AI面部分析工具、双语混合情绪启发式（BHMH）方案、AI支持的对话工具、心理健康资源、同伴支持小组和治疗师沟通。该应用程序通过一项涉及200名受访者的用户调查进行评估，以评估可用性、感知有用性、情绪觉察、隐私和用户接受度。调查回答显示对REWAA的总体积极看法。大多数受访者将图形用户界面评为舒适且易于导航（70%），而60%报告称REWAA机器人帮助他们更好地理解自己的感受并提供了实用建议。此外，55%报告情绪觉察显著改善，65%认为该应用程序与专业治疗一起使用有帮助。总体而言，研究结果表明用户对该应用程序的可及性和集成支持功能持积极看法。REWAA展示了双语数字平台将情绪自我追踪、支持性资源和治疗师互动整合到一个应用程序中的潜力。然而，研究结果主要反映用户报告的可用性和接受度，并未确立临床诊断准确性或治疗有效性。需要进一步的评估，包括适当的临床验证和纵向随访，以评估其在真实世界心理健康环境中的有效性和可靠性。

abstract: Background: Targeted therapy for patients with suspected respiratory infections traditionally requires bacterial culture followed by phenotypic antimicrobial susceptibility testing (AST), a process that can take up to 5 days. In acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), delays in identifying the causative pathogen and its resistance profile may be especially harmful because patients are critically ill and often receive broad-spectrum empiric antibiotics. The growing burden of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) further complicates clinical decision-making by reducing effective treatment options and increasing the risk of inadequate initial therapy. Culture-free, AI-driven computational metagenomic strategies have the potential to drastically shorten this window, enabling more rapid targeted therapy prescription. To show the feasibility of such approaches, we develop a proof-of-concept framework based on clinical metagenomics. Methods: We simulated respiratory metagenomes using real-world bacterial genomes with associated antimicrobial susceptibility phenotypes. Each simulated metagenome contained a fixed commensal background and one clinically important respiratory pathogen, Acinetobacter baumannii, Klebsiella pneumoniae, or Pseudomonas aeruginosa, at 5% or 10% bacterial read abundance. Realistic reads were simulated for Oxford Nanopore, PacBio, and Illumina sequencing platforms. Random Forest (RF) classifiers were trained and evaluated using five-fold, strain-grouped cross-validation with fold-specific {chi}2-ranked 13-mer features. ResFinder and KARGA were included as reference-based metagenomics benchmarks and evaluated using the same five held-out folds across the three sequencing platforms and two pathogen-abundance conditions. Results: RF performance varied substantially across species, antibiotics, and sequencing platforms. The strongest and most consistent results were observed for K. pneumoniae, with accuracy reaching approximately 0.96 for ceftazidime, 0.93 for amikacin, and 0.92 for ciprofloxacin. Performance for P. aeruginosa was more heterogeneous: long-read models performed well for amikacin, reaching 0.89 with PacBio and 0.88 with Nanopore, whereas Illumina performed substantially better for ciprofloxacin, ceftazidime, and levofloxacin, reaching accuracies of approximately 0.87, 0.77, and 0.70, respectively. title: What Does an Agent-Run Clinic Cost? Protocol for a Prospective Observational Study of the Compute Cost of Completed Work in a Clinical Agent Fleet

abstract: Background: Decisions about deploying large language model (LLM) agents in health care require the cost of completed work in production. Published evidence reports benchmark accuracy, benchmark-level cost, and time or financial outcomes for ambient documentation, and list prices alone do not determine the cost of completed work. To our knowledge, no deployed clinical agent fleet has published a measurement method that ties compute cost, latency, failures and retries to completed work. Objective: This study aims to estimate the compute cost of completed work by the orchestrated clinical agents of a deployed LLM agent fleet over a 12-week window of production telemetry, using estimators, data-quality gates and an analysis plan fixed before any window data are extracted for the study. Methods: The setting is a private outpatient clinic in London, United Kingdom, where wai, a multi-agent system supporting clinic operations, is deployed. The population is every run of the 20 orchestrated clinical documentation and decision-support agents starting between September 21 and December 13, 2026. The run store writes 2 records for every run, a non-terminal record before the model call and a terminal record after it, and has no attempt counter or parent-run link. Estimators defined on that structure cover cost per resolved execution and per completed intention, retry and failed-intention shares of compute, error and failure rates, latency, cost per draft offered for clinician review and a latency-cost frontier, by agent, task class and acceptance stratum. Cost is recorded in GBP pence, converted from provider-returned US dollar cost at a fixed rate and rounded per model call. The plan fixes weekly aggregation, small-cell suppression, bootstrap intervals over weeks, 2 prespecified comparisons, 5 sensitivity analyses and 4 data-quality gates whose failure converts an estimate into a bound or an unmeasured stratum. Two staff-level measures in an earlier version were dropped. Revenue, pricing, margin and staffing inference are excluded. Results: The measurement window opened on September 21, 2026, and closes on December 13, 2026, and telemetry is being recorded in routine operation. No window data had been extracted for this study at submission. Aggregate whole-table counts that include window records were extracted on November 19, 2026, for companion manuscripts and are disclosed. title: How predictable is an individual's DNA methylation?
zh_title: 个体DNA甲基化可预测性有多高
summary: 预印本将个体差异位点的甲基化预测作为新任务，并区分低变异与高变异位点分别评估预测表现。
key_points: 现有方法按全位点准确率评估，掩盖个体差异位点表现

abstract: DNA methylation is largely shared among individuals of the same cell type, yet at specific genomic sites it differs substantially between individuals. Methods that predict methylation are usually evaluated by their accuracy over all sites. Because methylation at most sites is shared, this accuracy cannot show whether a method predicts an individual's methylation where individuals differ. We present individual-level methylation prediction at sites where individuals differ as a new challenge. Given the reference genome sequence, the methylation of other individuals of the same cell type, and measurements at some sites of a target individual, but not the individual's genotype, the task is to predict the target individual's methylation class (unmethylated, intermediate, or methylated) at the remaining sites. We evaluate predictions separately at sites with low and high variation across individuals. We compare four approaches: the average of other individuals, a sequence model (the DNA language model Nucleotide Transformer) fine-tuned on other individuals' methylation, the same model further fine-tuned on the target individual's measurements, and a local class-average approach using the target individual's nearby training-site class labels. Across 32 individuals from six human cell types, the average of other individuals matched or slightly exceeded both sequence models at sites with low variation among individuals. At the most variable sites, the average of other individuals performed worse than a random predictor that assigns classes at the observed class frequencies, whereas both sequence models performed substantially better than the average. Both sequence models also achieved higher mean weighted F1 than the local class-average approach. Fine-tuning on the target individual's measurements improved predictions more inside regions where other individuals show bimodal methylation (a mix of methylated and unmethylated DNA molecules within one sample) than outside them. Among the most variable sites, it also improved predictions at CpG islands for 25 of the 32 individuals. We conclude that individual-level methylation prediction is a distinct problem that is particularly challenging at sites where individuals differ, and that the benefit of an individual's own measurements is concentrated in genomic contexts identifiable from other individuals' methylation and genomic annotations.
zh_abstract: DNA甲基化在同一细胞类型的个体之间在很大程度上是共享的，但在特定基因组位点上，个体之间差异显著。预测甲基化的方法通常通过其在所有位点上的准确性来评估。由于大多数位点的甲基化是共享的，这种准确性无法表明方法是否能在个体间存在差异的位点预测某个个体的甲基化。我们提出将个体间存在差异位点上的个体水平甲基化预测作为一个新挑战。给定参考基因组序列、同一细胞类型其他个体的甲基化、以及目标个体在某些位点的测量值，但不提供该个体的基因型，任务是在其余位点预测目标个体的甲基化类别（未甲基化、中间或甲基化）。我们在个体间变异低和高的位点分别评估预测。我们比较四种方法：其他个体的平均值；在其他个体甲基化上微调的序列模型（DNA语言模型Nucleotide Transformer）；同一模型进一步在目标个体的测量值上微调；以及使用目标个体邻近训练位点类别标签的局部类别平均方法。在来自六种人类细胞类型的32名个体中，在个体间变异低的位点，其他个体的平均值与两个序列模型相当或略优于二者。在变异最大的位点，其他个体的平均值表现差于按观察到的类别频率分配类别的随机预测器，而两个序列模型的表现均显著优于该平均值。两个序列模型的平均加权F1也均高于局部类别平均方法。在目标个体测量值上进行微调，对预测的改善在其他个体显示双峰甲基化（同一样本中甲基化与未甲基化DNA分子的混合）的区域内部大于这些区域外部。在变异最大的位点中，它还在32名个体中的25名中改善了CpG岛的预测。我们得出结论：个体水平甲基化预测是一个独特的问题，在个体间存在差异的位点尤其具有挑战性；个体自身测量值的获益集中在可由其他个体甲基化和基因组注释识别的基因组背景中。

title: Co-occurrence Is Not Evidence: Separating Protein-Disease Findings from Incidental Mentions in HFpEF Literature
zh_title: 共现非证据：区分蛋白-疾病发现与附带提及
summary: 用PubMedBERT集成过滤HFpEF文献中的蛋白提及，区分关联、无关联与附带提及。
key_points: 300句保留集仅115句断言生物学关联
微调PubMedBERT并采用类别加权与R-Drop
六模型多数投票集成达85.3%准确率、86.1%宏F1
reason: 小规模保留集上的文献过滤方法，预印本且证据有限
abstract: Literature-mining pipelines such as CaseOLAP rank proteins by how often they appear next to a disease term. Appearing next to a disease is not the same as being implicated in it: in our 300-sentence held-out set of PubMed sentences that mention a protein and heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF), only 115 assert a biological association. The rest report a negative finding or mention the protein in passing, for example as a drug the patients were taking. We train a sentence-level filter that sorts each protein mention into associated, not_associated or incidental. It is a fine-tuned PubMedBERT trained with class-weighted cross-entropy and R-Drop regularization, combined into a six-model majority-vote ensemble over three random seeds. On the held-out set, with no thresholds tuned on it, the ensemble reaches 85.3% accuracy and 86.1% macro F1 (bootstrap 95% confidence intervals 81.0-89.3% and 82.1-89.7%), against 38.3% accuracy for the co-occurrence baseline, which counts every mention as an association. Single models average 84.4 +/- 0.7% accuracy across seeds. Run after CaseOLAP, the filter removes protein mentions that are not evidence of association from the HFpEF candidate list. Where the ensemble's majority vote disagreed with the annotation, the annotation was often wrong. Expert review of those sentences corrected 53 of 88 flagged evaluation labels and 109 training labels. Most of the errors came from one flaw in the annotation sheet: in sentences naming several proteins, it did not say which protein the label was for. The audit stage coincided with the largest accuracy gain in the project, but the same stage also changed the evaluation labels and the training loss, so we report it as a chronology, not as a controlled result.
zh_abstract: 诸如CaseOLAP的文献挖掘流程按蛋白质与疾病术语相邻出现的频率对蛋白质排序。与疾病相邻出现并不等同于与该疾病相关：在我们由300句PubMed句子构成的保留集中，这些句子提到某种蛋白质和射血分数保留的心力衰竭（HFpEF），只有115句断言存在生物学关联。其余报告阴性发现或仅顺带提及该蛋白质，例如作为患者正在服用的药物。我们训练一个句子级过滤器，将每个蛋白质提及分为关联、不关联或附带提及（associated、not_associated、incidental）。它是一个微调的PubMedBERT，使用类别加权交叉熵和R-Drop正则化训练，并合并为跨三个随机种子的六模型多数投票集成。在保留集上，未在其上调任何阈值，该集成达到85.3%准确率和86.1%宏F1（bootstrap 95%置信区间81.0-89.3%和82.1-89.7%），而共现基线为38.3%准确率，该基线将每次提及都计为关联。单模型跨种子平均准确率为84.4 +/- 0.7%。在CaseOLAP之后运行，该过滤器从HFpEF候选列表中移除不构成关联证据的蛋白质提及。当集成的多数投票与标注不一致时，标注常常是错的。对这些句子的专家复核纠正了88个被标记评估标签中的53个和109个训练标签。大多数错误来自标注表的一个缺陷：在命名多个蛋白质的句子中，它没有说明标签针对哪个蛋白质。审计阶段与项目中最大的准确率提升同时发生，但同一阶段也改变了评估标签和训练损失，因此我们将其作为时间顺序报告，而不是作为受控结果。

title: Dependence-Aware Conformal Prediction for 3D Uncertainty Quantification in Molecular Docking
zh_title: 面向分子对接三维不确定性量化的依赖性感知共形预测
summary: 提出基于图神经网络与Copula联合校准的共形预测框架，为分子对接三维位姿给出紧凑且可靠联合覆盖的预测区域。
key_points: 以共享GNN估计原子级自适应非对称不确定区间
用Copula刻画坐标间依赖，做联合校准
针对原子误差异质与分布偏移问题
reason: 预印本方法创新但仅有方法描述，无外部验证与对照结果，属增量档
abstract: Molecular docking plays a critical role in drug discovery by predicting three-dimensional (3D) binding poses of small molecules within proteins. However, docking predictions can contain substantial positional errors, making reliable uncertainty quantification essential. Conformal prediction (CP) provides a principled framework for uncertainty quantification, yet constructing compact 3D prediction regions with reliable joint coverage remains challenging due to heterogeneous atomic errors, dependence among spatial coordinates, and distribution shifts. We develop a dependence-aware CP framework for molecular docking that leverages a shared graph neural network (GNN) to estimate adaptive, asymmetric uncertainty intervals using local atomic and global molecular information. Copula-based joint calibration accounts for dependence among coordinate-wise nonconformity scores to construct compact 3D prediction boxes. We further introduce density ratio estimation (DRE) to adapt calibration under distribution shift. Experiments across three docking methods demonstrate that our approach reduces median prediction-box volumes by 37.40%, 95.00%, and 39.16% for AutoDock Vina, Protenix, and MedusaGraph, respectively, compared with a state-of-the-art CP baseline, while achieving empirical joint coverage close to the 90% target. Under the Molecular Group Split and controlled distribution shifts, DRE further reduces coverage deviations, highlighting the potential of dependence-aware and shift-adaptive calibration for reliable 3D molecular docking uncertainty quantification.
zh_abstract: 分子对接通过预测小分子在蛋白质内的三维（3D）结合构象，在药物发现中发挥关键作用。然而，对接预测可能包含显著的位置误差，因此可靠的不确定性量化至关重要。共形预测（CP）为不确定性量化提供了原则性框架，但由于异质原子误差、空间坐标间的依赖以及分布偏移，构建具有可靠联合覆盖的紧凑3D预测区域仍具挑战性。我们开发了一个用于分子对接的依赖感知CP框架，利用共享图神经网络（GNN），结合局部原子和全局分子信息来估计自适应、非对称的不确定性区间。基于Copula的联合校准考虑坐标级非一致性得分之间的依赖关系，以构建紧凑的3D预测框。我们进一步引入密度比估计（DRE），以在分布偏移下调整校准。在三种对接方法上的实验表明，与最先进的CP基线相比，我们的方法使AutoDock Vina、Protenix和MedusaGraph的中位预测框体积分别减少37.40%、95.00%和39.16%，同时经验联合覆盖率接近90%的目标。在分子组划分（Molecular Group Split）和受控分布偏移下，DRE进一步降低了覆盖率偏差，突显了依赖感知和偏移自适应校准在可靠3D分子对接不确定性量化中的潜力。

title: Separating Genetic and Protein Evidence in Open Targets: An Auditable Re-ranking Study
zh_title: Open Targets遗传与蛋白证据分通道重排序
summary: 在Open Targets中把遗传与蛋白证据分通道评分后再融合，重排AD与PD靶点。
key_points: AD平台前20含7个遗传支持基因和10个症状药理对照
默认晚期融合含15个遗传基因、无对照
PD晚期融合保留13个遗传基因并去除5个对照
reason: 预印本靶点排序分析，范围窄且无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Biomedical target-ranking platforms combine genetics, literature, experimental evidence, tractability, and clinical precedent because each is useful for target discovery. A single integrated score, however, can be awkward to reuse for a narrower question such as which genes have direct evidence for disease risk or etiology. We examine this issue in Open Targets associations for Alzheimer disease (AD) and Parkinson disease (PD). Genetics-linked evidence and protein-oriented evidence are scored in separate channels and combined only at the end. In AD, the Open Targets overall top 20 contains 7 curated genetics-supported genes and 10 symptomatic pharmacology controls; the default late fusion contains 15 curated genes and no symptomatic controls. In PD, late fusion retains 13 curated genes and removes the 5 symptomatic controls present in the platform top 20. A genetics-only ranking reaches similar curated recall (14 genes in AD, 13 in PD), so most of the gain over the platform score comes from emphasizing genetic evidence; the protein channel mainly raises the number of tractable targets in the shortlist (from 9 to 12 in AD and from 8 to 10 in PD) without readmitting symptomatic controls. These results are stable across fusion weights from 0.35 to 0.75, perturbed protein-channel weights, and rule thresholds. An optional post-ranking rule further lowers high-clinical/low-genetic targets such as ACHE and GRIN1 without changing top-20 curated recall. The procedure is deterministic and uses public Open Targets fields. Because the component scores remain available, individual rank changes can be inspected and the ranking can be reproduced from the same data snapshot.
zh_abstract: 生物医学靶点排序平台整合遗传学、文献、实验证据、可成药性（tractability）和临床先例，因为每一类信息对靶点发现都有用。然而，单一整合评分在用于更窄的问题（例如哪些基因有直接证据支持疾病风险或病因）时可能难以复用。我们在阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer disease, AD）和帕金森病（Parkinson disease, PD）的 Open Targets 关联中考察了这一问题。与遗传学相关的证据和以蛋白质为导向的证据在单独通道中评分，仅在最后合并。在 AD 中，Open Targets 总体前 20 名包含 7 个经人工整理（curated）的遗传学支持基因和 10 个对症药理学对照；默认的晚期融合包含 15 个经人工整理的基因，且不含对症对照。在 PD 中，晚期融合保留 13 个经人工整理的基因，并移除平台前 20 名中存在的 5 个对症对照。仅遗传学排序达到相似的经人工整理召回（AD 中 14 个基因，PD 中 13 个），因此相对于平台评分的大部分增益来自强调遗传学证据；蛋白质通道主要提高短名单中可成药靶点的数量（AD 中从 9 增至 12，PD 中从 8 增至 10），而不会重新纳入对症对照。这些结果在 0.35 至 0.75 的融合权重、扰动蛋白质通道权重以及规则阈值下均稳定。一个可选的排序后规则进一步降低高临床/低遗传学靶点（如 ACHE 和 GRIN1）的排名，而不改变前 20 名经人工整理召回。该流程是确定性的，并使用公开的 Open Targets 字段。由于各组分评分仍然可用，可以检查单个排名变化，并且可以从同一数据快照重现该排序。

title: Trustworthy Speech-Based Autism Screening under Class Imbalance with Uncertainty-Aware HuBERT Ensembles
zh_title: HuBERT集成与不确定性估计的语音自闭症筛查
summary: 用HuBERT自监督表征结合平衡k-bagging与MC Dropout，在儿童病理语音库上做自闭症筛查并输出不确定性。
key_points: 采用留一受试者交叉验证与平衡k-bagging集成
语句级平衡准确率86.30%，受试者级95.04%
强调类别不平衡下需可靠的不确定性估计
reason: 单一声学数据集、无外部验证的预印本，属增量档偏上
abstract: Early screening of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is critical for timely clinical intervention, although establishing reliable speech based screening systems remains problematic due to limited clinical data, class imbalance, and the need for reliable uncertainty estimation. We propose an uncertainty-aware ASD screening framework based on self-supervised HuBERT representations, combining Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) crossvalidation, balanced k-bagging, and Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout. Multiple HuBERT models are fine-tuned on balanced subsets, with predictions combined through probability-based ensemble averaging and aggregated at the subject level. Experiments on the Child Pathological Speech Database (CPSD) show strong performance, achieving 86.30% balanced accuracy and 93.74% ROC-AUC at the utterance level, and 95.04% and 96.30%, respectively, at the subject level. Furthermore, predictive entropy effectively reflects classification reliability: incorrectly classified segments show higher entropy than correctly classified ones (0.4605 $\pm$ 0.2314 vs. 0.1717 $\pm$ 0.1830), with a significant correlation with errors (r = 0.3981, p = 7.38 x 10 -170 ) and an error-detection ROC-AUC of 0.8359. These results demonstrate the potential of the proposed framework as a robust and uncertainty-aware computer-aided tool for ASD screening.
zh_abstract: 自闭症谱系障碍（Autism Spectrum Disorder, ASD）的早期筛查对于及时临床干预至关重要，但由于临床数据有限、类别不平衡以及需要可靠的不确定性估计，建立可靠的基于语音的筛查系统仍然存在问题。我们提出了一种基于自监督 HuBERT 表征的不确定性感知 ASD 筛查框架，结合留一受试者交叉验证（Leave-One-Subject-Out, LOSO）、平衡 k-bagging 和蒙特卡洛（Monte Carlo, MC）Dropout。多个 HuBERT 模型在平衡子集上微调，通过基于概率的集成平均合并预测，并在受试者层面聚合。在儿童病理语音数据库（Child Pathological Speech Database, CPSD）上的实验显示出强劲性能，在语句层面达到 86.30% 的平衡准确率和 93.74% 的 ROC-AUC，在受试者层面分别达到 95.04% 和 96.30%。此外，预测熵有效反映分类可靠性：错误分类片段显示出高于正确分类片段的熵（0.4605 ± 0.2314 对 0.1717 ± 0.1830），与错误显著相关（r = 0.3981，p = 7.38 × 10⁻¹⁷⁰），错误检测 ROC-AUC 为 0.8359。这些结果表明所提出框架作为稳健且不确定性感知的 ASD 筛查计算机辅助工具的潜力。

title: UniDR: Learning To Generate Anatomical Deformations From Images via Unified Diffusion Modeling and Registration
zh_title: UniDR：扩散建模与配准统一的解剖形变生成
summary: 将条件扩散模型与配准联合优化，在保持拓扑的前提下从图像生成解剖形变场。
key_points: 扩散模型与配准过程联合优化，减少误差传播
提出配准引导的分数匹配目标函数
声称保持解剖结构的拓扑一致性
reason: 通用配准方法预印本，摘要无临床数据或外部验证，属增量档
abstract: This paper presents a novel framework, Unified Diffusion modeling and Registration (UniDR), which learns to generate arbitrary anatomical deformations from images with preserved topology. Existing approaches often model the generative process separately from registration-based deformation estimation; hence making them prone to propagated errors from the registration stage. To address this limitation, we propose a unified paradigm based on a conditional diffusion model over deformation fields that are jointly optimized from the registration process. A principled registration-guided score-matching objective function is then introduced to align the diffusion process with the deformation distribution induced by registration. As a result, our UniDR establishes an explicit connection between generation and registration: the diffusion model enables exploration of the space of plausible anatomical deformations, whereas registration provides structured supervision for learning transformations consistent with observed images. Once trained, UniDR is able to sample diverse, anatomically plausible transformations conditioned on any single input image. We evaluate UniDR across multiple real-world applications and demonstrate its effectiveness in generating high-fidelity image samples compared to the state-of-the-art. Additionally, we demonstrate that these generated samples improve performance in downstream medical image analysis and vision tasks.
zh_abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖框架——统一扩散建模与配准（Unified Diffusion modeling and Registration, UniDR），它学习从图像生成保持拓扑的任意解剖形变。现有方法通常将生成过程与基于配准的形变估计分开建模；因此容易受到配准阶段传播误差的影响。为解决这一局限，我们提出一种统一范式，基于形变场上的条件扩散模型，该形变场由配准过程联合优化。随后引入有原则的配准引导的分数匹配目标函数，使扩散过程与配准诱导的形变分布对齐。因此，我们的 UniDR 在生成与配准之间建立了显式联系：扩散模型能够探索合理的解剖形变空间，而配准提供结构化监督，以学习与观测图像一致的变换。训练完成后，UniDR 能够以任意单张输入图像为条件，采样多样且解剖上合理的变换。我们在多个真实世界应用中评估 UniDR，并证明其相较于最先进方法在生成高保真图像样本方面的有效性。此外，我们证明这些生成的样本改善了下游医学图像分析和视觉任务的性能。

title: Precision diabetes care through advanced clinical assessment biomarkers artificial intelligence and personalized therapeutics.
source: PubMed · Therapeutic advances in endocrinology and metabolism
zh_title: 糖尿病精准医疗中的生物标志物与AI决策支持综述
summary: 综述梳理精准糖尿病诊疗所涉生物标志物、组学、可穿戴与AI决策支持系统等研究方向。
key_points: 讨论临床、遗传、分子、代谢等多层数据整合
涵盖CGM、可穿戴与数字健康技术
提及AI决策支持用于分层与治疗选择
reason: 泛综述、AI仅为其中一节，无具体研究数据，按综述上限属增量档
abstract: [Therapeutic advances in endocrinology and metabolism] There is a great heterogeneity in disease characteristics, progression, manifestations, and treatment efficacy that make population-level strategies based on diabetes mellitus ineffective. Precision medicine provides ways to tackle this disparity by combining clinical, genetic, molecular, metabolic and behavioural data with the goal of personalized diagnosis, risk stratification or choosing treatment. This review covers a comprehensive and clinically relevant assessment of personalized diabetes care and the emerging research areas of the associated biomarkers, genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, epigenomics, pharmacogenomics, nutrigenomics, continuous glucose monitoring, wearable technologies, digital health and artificial intelligence-based decision support systems. Molecular characterization, patient stratification, personalised pharmacotherapy, lifestyle intervention, and long-term digital monitoring is integrated with these technologies rather than being considered separate entities. The main focus is on the clinical and/or translational implications of these strategies, such as their current evidence strength and their limitations, population diversity, external validation, cost-effectiveness, data interoperability, privacy and healthcare implementation. Combining the multi-omics and real-time digital information with traditional clinical evaluation could make it possible to better manage diabetes in a more predictive, adaptive, patient-centred manner. Yet, future validation, standardized analysis tools, access, and tools to be designed into standard clinical practice are still vital to bringing precision diabetes strategies from novel technologies into practical care.
zh_abstract: [《内分泌学与代谢的治疗进展》] 疾病特征、进展、表现和治疗疗效存在很大异质性，这使得基于糖尿病的人群层面策略效果不佳。精准医学通过结合临床、遗传、分子、代谢和行为数据，以实现个体化诊断、风险分层或选择治疗，从而应对这种差异。本综述对个体化糖尿病照护以及相关生物标志物、基因组学、转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学、表观基因组学、药物基因组学、营养基因组学、持续葡萄糖监测、可穿戴技术、数字健康和基于人工智能的决策支持系统等新兴研究领域进行了全面且具有临床相关性的评估。分子特征描述、患者分层、个体化药物治疗、生活方式干预和长期数字监测与这些技术整合，而非被视为彼此独立的实体。主要关注这些策略的临床和/或转化意义，例如其当前证据强度及其局限性、人群多样性、外部验证、成本效益、数据互操作性、隐私和医疗实施。将多组学和实时数字信息与传统临床评估相结合，有可能以更具预测性、适应性和以患者为中心的方式更好地管理糖尿病。然而，未来验证、标准化分析工具、可及性以及设计用于标准临床实践的工具，对于将精准糖尿病策略从新技术带入实际照护仍然至关重要。

title: Medical Specialty Prediction from Bangla Patient Narratives: A Comparative Study of ML, DL, Transformers, and LLMs
zh_title: 孟加拉语患者叙述的专科分诊模型比较研究
summary: 基于3798条孟加拉语患者叙述比较机器学习、深度学习、Transformer与LLM在20个专科分诊预测上的表现。
key_points: 最终纳入2730条记录、5个专科，80:20划分
最优为XLM-RoBERTa，准确率86.26%
单语料内部划分，无外部验证
reason: 单数据集内部划分、无外部验证的预印本，属增量档
abstract: Timely access to appropriate medical specialists remains a bottleneck in Bangladesh's healthcare system, as patients describe symptoms in informal Bangla rather than clinical terms, leading to ineffective referrals. This paper compares four model families for predicting medical specialties from Bangla patient narratives: six machine learning (ML) models using hybrid TF-IDF features, four deep learning (DL) models using Word2Vec embeddings trained on the corpus, four fine-tuned transformers, and five large language models (LLMs) evaluated zero-shot. From a corpus of 3798 patient records covering 20 specialties, we retained the five with the most records (Medicine, Gynecology, Dermatology, Pediatrics, Gastroenterology) and split the resulting 2730 records 80:20 into training and test sets shared by all families. The best transformer was XLM-RoBERTa (86.26% accuracy, 86.21% macro-F1), the best ML model was SVM (84.98%, 84.92%), the best DL model was Bidirectional GRU (80.77%, 80.83%), and the best LLM was Gemini (90.29%, 90.15%). Holm-corrected paired McNemar tests show SVM significantly outperforming Bi-LSTM (adjusted p = 0.004), whereas the Gemini-versus-Grok gap does not survive correction (adjusted p = 0.104), and neither the strongest transformer versus the weakest LLM (Grok) nor SVM versus the strongest transformer reaches significance. A tuned classical model is thus statistically indistinguishable from the strongest transformer, so accuracy rankings alone should not be read as evidence of one family's superiority. The findings provide a comparative baseline for Bangla medical text classification.
zh_abstract: 在孟加拉国的医疗系统中，及时获得合适的专科医生仍然是一个瓶颈，因为患者用非正式孟加拉语而非临床术语描述症状，导致转诊无效。本文比较了四类模型家族，用于从孟加拉语患者叙述中预测医学专科：使用混合TF-IDF特征的六个机器学习（ML）模型、使用在语料库上训练的Word2Vec嵌入的四个深度学习（DL）模型、四个微调Transformer，以及五个零样本评估的大型语言模型（LLM）。从覆盖20个专科的3798份患者记录语料库中，我们保留了记录最多的五个专科（内科、妇科、皮肤科、儿科、胃肠病学），并将所得2730份记录按80:20分为所有模型家族共享的训练集和测试集。最佳Transformer是XLM-RoBERTa（准确率86.26%，宏F1 86.21%），最佳ML模型是SVM（84.98%，84.92%），最佳DL模型是双向GRU（80.77%，80.83%），最佳LLM是Gemini（90.29%，90.15%）。Holm校正的配对McNemar检验显示SVM显著优于Bi-LSTM（校正p=0.004），而Gemini与Grok之间的差距未能在校正后保持显著（校正p=0.104），并且最强Transformer与最弱LLM（Grok）之间、以及SVM与最强Transformer之间均未达到显著性。因此，经过调优的经典模型在统计上与最强Transformer无法区分，所以仅凭准确率排名不应被解读为某一模型家族优越的证据。研究结果为孟加拉语医学文本分类提供了比较基线。

title: GAG-Net: Graph-Based Anatomical Guidance Network for Pharyngeal Area Segmentation in VFSS Images
zh_title: GAG-Net：VFSS咽部区域分割的解剖引导网络
summary: 预印本提出图结构解剖引导网络用于吞咽造影图像咽部静息面积自动分割，并构建该任务首个数据集。
key_points: 将临床隐性测量转为显式标志点规范与标注流程
与康复医学专家合作构建该任务首个数据集
针对软组织边界不清与规则化勾画标准建模
reason: 新任务与新数据集但有仅有方法层面描述，缺乏外部验证，属增量档。
abstract: Diagnosing sarcopenic dysphagia typically requires costly supplementary imaging such as CT or MRI to assess muscle atrophy, burdening elderly patients. The pharyngeal area at rest (PA_rest), measurable directly from videofluoroscopic swallowing study (VFSS) images, is a promising biomarker that could eliminate this dependency, but repeated manual measurement has limited its adoption. PA_rest segmentation is further complicated by indistinct soft-tissue boundaries and clinical rule-based delineation criteria that data-driven models capture only imprecisely. We formulate automated PA_rest segmentation as a clinically defined measurement task, translating an implicit clinical measurement into an explicit landmark specification and annotation protocol developed with a rehabilitation medicine specialist. Applying this protocol, we constructed, to our knowledge, the first dataset for this task: 2,255 single-center VFSS frames from 137 patients, with PA_rest contours and seven landmarks verified by a senior specialist. We then introduce GAG-Net, an automated rest-frame measurement pipeline combining deformable convolutions, for irregular pharyngeal boundaries, with a graph-based anatomical guidance module that models the geometric dependencies among landmarks prescribed by the delineation rules. On a patient-level held-out test set (237 frames, 67 patients), GAG-Net achieved the lowest area measurement error (mean absolute percentage error: 8.17% against specialist-verified references; patient-level ICC 0.97) and the highest Dice score (0.8862) among all evaluated methods, with 67.2% fewer parameters and 74% less training memory than the two-stage JOINED model. Integrating clinician-defined anatomical knowledge may enable automated PA_rest measurement from VFSS images alone, supporting quantitative assessment of sarcopenic dysphagia without supplementary imaging.
zh_abstract: 诊断肌少症性吞咽困难通常需要昂贵的补充影像学检查（如CT或MRI）来评估肌肉萎缩，给老年患者带来负担。静息咽部面积（PA_rest）可直接从电视透视吞咽研究（VFSS）图像中测量，是一种有前景的生物标志物，可能消除这种依赖，但重复的手工测量限制了其采用。PA_rest分割进一步因软组织边界不清以及临床基于规则的勾画标准而复杂化，数据驱动模型只能不精确地捕捉这些标准。我们将自动PA_rest分割表述为一项临床定义的测量任务，将隐含的临床测量转化为明确的地标规格和标注方案，该方案与一位康复医学专家共同制定。应用该方案，我们构建了据我们所知该任务的首个数据集：来自137例患者的2,255帧单中心VFSS图像，其PA_rest轮廓和七个地标由一位资深专家核验。随后我们提出GAG-Net，一种自动静息帧测量流程，将可变形卷积（用于不规则咽部边界）与基于图的解剖引导模块相结合，该模块对勾画规则所规定的各地标之间的几何依赖关系进行建模。在患者级别留出测试集（237帧，67例患者）上，GAG-Net在所有评估方法中取得了最低的面积测量误差（相对于专家核验参考的平均绝对百分比误差：8.17%；患者级别ICC 0.97）和最高的Dice分数（0.8862），且与两阶段JOINED模型相比，参数量减少67.2%，训练内存减少74%。整合临床医生定义的解剖知识可能使仅凭VFSS图像进行自动PA_rest测量成为可能，从而支持无需补充影像学的肌少症性吞咽困难定量评估。

title: ATLAS: Autoregressive Trajectories for Longitudinal Analysis of Survival
zh_title: ATLAS：自回归轨迹用于纵向生存分析
summary: 提出ATLAS框架，按患者协变量与历史自回归采样未来轨迹，估计生存与累积发生率曲线。
key_points: 以序列模型生成患者个体化合成队列
由合成轨迹估计Kaplan-Meier与Aalen-Johansen曲线
仅用两个随机有限状态自动机基准评测
与八种直接生存模型（含DRSA、Dynamic-DeepHit）比较
reason: 方法有新意但仅在合成基准上验证，无真实临床队列与外部验证
abstract: Dynamic survival prediction requires estimates that reflect a patient's observed clinical history. We introduce ATLAS (Autoregressive Trajectories for Longitudinal Analysis of Survival), a framework that trains a sequence model on longitudinal data and autoregressively samples possible futures conditional on an individual's covariates and observed history. These trajectories form a patient-specific synthetic cohort from which Kaplan-Meier survival curves and Aalen-Johansen cumulative incidence curves are estimated. We evaluate ATLAS using two stochastic finite-state automaton benchmarks with exact conditional reference curves: a single-covariate process with duration dependence and a late rule change, and a three-covariate Markov process with recovery and competing causes of death. Comparisons include eight direct survival models, including validation-optimized DRSA and Dynamic-DeepHit and history-aware SurvTRACE adaptations, with each neural model trained nine times in the first experiment and five times in the second. After baseline, every ATLAS configuration had lower mean survival-curve error than every fitted direct comparator in both experiments. With a common Sobol sampler and 10,000 trajectories per patient, the best ATLAS model did so in every individual training run, and its mean error was 62% to 84% lower than that of the strongest direct comparator. Baseline advantages were smaller and less consistent in the duration-dependent experiment. ATLAS provides a generative framework for history-conditioned survival estimation, while the accompanying benchmarks enable direct assessment of individual survival and competing-risk predictions against known reference curves.
zh_abstract: 动态生存预测需要能够反映患者已观察临床病史的估计。我们引入 ATLAS（Autoregressive Trajectories for Longitudinal Analysis of Survival，纵向生存分析的自回归轨迹），这是一个在纵向数据上训练序列模型，并以个体协变量和观察史为条件自回归地采样可能未来的框架。这些轨迹形成患者特异性合成队列，从中估计 Kaplan-Meier 生存曲线和 Aalen-Johansen 累积发生率曲线。我们使用两个具有精确条件参考曲线的随机有限状态自动机基准评估 ATLAS：一个具有持续时间依赖性和后期规则变化的单协变量过程，以及一个具有康复和竞争性死亡原因的三协变量马尔可夫过程。比较对象包括八个直接生存模型，其中有经验证优化的 DRSA 和 Dynamic-DeepHit，以及历史感知的 SurvTRACE 适配版本；每个神经模型在第一个实验中训练九次，在第二个实验中训练五次。在基线之后，两个实验中每个 ATLAS 配置的平均生存曲线误差均低于每个已拟合的直接比较模型。使用共同的 Sobol 采样器且每名患者 10,000 条轨迹时，最佳 ATLAS 模型在每一次单独训练运行中均如此，其平均误差比最强的直接比较模型低 62% 至 84%。在持续时间依赖实验中，基线优势较小且较不一致。ATLAS 为以病史为条件的生存估计提供了一个生成式框架，而配套基准能够对照已知参考曲线直接评估个体生存预测和竞争风险预测。

title: One-shot is Enough: Boosting SAM for Medical Image Segmentation through Structured Information Modeling
zh_title: OB-SAM：单样本增强的医学图像分割框架
summary: 针对SAM在医学图像单样本场景性能下降的问题，提出结构化建模的单样本增强框架OB-SAM，含多频解耦模块。
key_points: SAM在自然图像预训练，直接用于医学图像效果差
单样本学习可缓解标注数据稀缺与高成本
提出多频解耦模块从单样本中挖掘多粒度信息
reason: 方法模块改进类预印本，无外部验证与临床结局，属增量档
abstract: In recent years, Foundation models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) have demonstrated strong generalization capabilities, but because they are primarily pre-trained on natural images, they perform poorly when faced with medical images. With sufficient labeled medical data, this challenge is somewhat alleviated. However, the difficulty and high cost of acquiring large amounts of labeled data make one-shot learning a highly attractive research paradigm. But within this paradigm, SAM struggles to fully extract its potential multi-granular information, leading to a sharp decline in performance. To address this, we propose OB-SAM, a one-shot enhancement framework for medical image segmentation. It aims to maximize the utilization of information from a single sample from the perspective of structured modeling. Specifically, we first designed a Multi-Frequency Decoupling (MFD) module, which divides features into different frequency domain components, allowing each branch to focus on information expression at different semantic levels, thereby alleviating overfitting and enhancing feature representation capabilities. Secondly, we introduce a Progressive Feature Integrator (PFI) module to promote complementary fusion among multi-level features, thereby avoiding the dominant effect of a certain level of feature in the fusion process. Furthermore, we propose an Selective Context Filtering (SCF) Module that adaptively selects key contextual information by modeling the contrast relationship between the foreground and background, thereby achieving precise localization of the lesion area. Extensive experiments across seven diverse datasets validate that OB-SAM achieves state-of-the-art performance.
zh_abstract: 近年来，Segment Anything Model（SAM）等基础模型（Foundation models）已展现出强大的泛化能力，但由于它们主要是在自然图像上预训练，面对医学图像时表现不佳。在拥有充足标注医学数据的情况下，这一挑战可在一定程度上得到缓解。然而，获取大量标注数据的难度和高昂成本使单样本学习（one-shot learning）成为一种极具吸引力的研究范式。但在该范式下，SAM 难以充分提取其潜在的多粒度信息，导致性能急剧下降。为解决这一问题，我们提出 OB-SAM，一种用于医学图像分割的单样本增强框架。它旨在从结构化建模的角度最大化利用单个样本中的信息。具体而言，我们首先设计了多频解耦（Multi-Frequency Decoupling, MFD）模块，该模块将特征划分为不同频域分量，使每个分支关注不同语义层级的信息表达，从而缓解过拟合并增强特征表示能力。其次，我们引入渐进式特征整合器（Progressive Feature Integrator, PFI）模块，促进多层级特征之间的互补融合，从而避免某一层级特征在融合过程中占据主导作用。此外，我们提出选择性上下文过滤（Selective Context Filtering, SCF）模块，通过建模前景与背景之间的对比关系来自适应选择关键上下文信息，从而实现对病灶区域的精确定位。在七个多样化数据集上的大量实验验证，OB-SAM 取得了最先进的性能。

title: Controlled One-Click Benchmarking and Post-Fusion Recalibration for Support-Conditioned Medical Segmentation
zh_title: 医学分割的单点击基准与融合后重校准
summary: 提出受控单点击评测协议与支持感知重校准模块SAR，在三个公开分割数据集上以匹配预算比较Dice-AUC与IoU-AUC。
key_points: 每图仅一次正点击，验证集选检查点，不调阈值
SAR在支持-查询融合后做空间门控与通道重校准
BUSI、NerveUS、Kvasir-SEG三数据集固定697样本预算比较
reason: 仅公开数据集小样本回顾性比较，无外部临床验证，属增量档
abstract: Sparse-prompt medical segmentation is hard to compare when prompts, supports, thresholds, and splits differ. This paper uses a controlled one-click protocol: each test image receives one positive foreground click, training-only support, validation-only checkpoint selection, and no test-time threshold tuning. We propose {Support-Aware Recalibration (SAR)}, a late post-fusion recalibration block for MultiverSeg that combines large-kernel spatial gating with squeeze-and-excitation channel recalibration after support--query fusion. BUSI, NerveUS-BP-present, and Kvasir-SEG are evaluated with matched 697 foreground-present sample budgets, shared splits/clicks, and threshold-free Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC. Compared with a protocol-matched raw-support MultiverSeg baseline, the main SAR configuration shows favorable mean Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC performance on BUSI, NerveUS-BP-present, and Kvasir-SEG, while reducing logged training time in this implementation. These controlled results indicate that late post-fusion recalibration is useful under a leakage-controlled one-click protocol.
zh_abstract: 当提示、支持集、阈值和划分不同时，稀疏提示医学分割难以比较。本文采用受控的一键协议：每张测试图像获得一次正前景点击，仅使用训练集支持，仅基于验证集选择检查点，且测试时不进行阈值调优。我们提出 {Support-Aware Recalibration (SAR)}，这是用于 MultiverSeg 的晚期融合后重校准模块，在支持集—查询融合之后将大核空间门控与压缩-激励（squeeze-and-excitation）通道重校准相结合。BUSI、NerveUS-BP-present 和 Kvasir-SEG 在匹配的 697 个含前景样本预算、共享划分/点击以及无阈值 Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC 下进行评估。与协议匹配的原始支持集 MultiverSeg 基线相比，主要 SAR 配置在 BUSI、NerveUS-BP-present 和 Kvasir-SEG 上显示出较好的平均 Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC 性能，同时在该实现中减少了记录的训练时间。这些受控结果表明，在泄漏受控的一键协议下，晚期融合后重校准是有用的。

title: TesseraFlow: Scalable Video Diffusion for Dynamic Medical Imaging Inverse Problems
zh_title: TesseraFlow：面向动态医学影像的视频扩散先验
summary: 提出复数像素空间流先验，用低分辨率全局编码器与浅解码器降低动态医学影像重建中视频扩散先验的计算开销。
key_points: 复数像素空间流先验，替代潜空间视频先验
全局编码器每步仅读每帧低分辨率视图
浅解码器减少重叠窗口等采样开销
reason: 预印本新方法，但条目未给出定量结果、基线对比与外部验证，属增量档。
abstract: Generative priors are state-of-the-art for modeling medical images in image reconstruction tasks, but reconstruction with video priors takes tens of seconds to minutes per frame. Latent priors inherit the errors of their autoencoder, the memory of pixel-space whole-frame priors grows with the frame size, and pixel-space patch priors are slow for two reasons. First, their deep networks process every frame at full resolution at every sampling step, even though early steps resolve only low frequencies. Second, their samplers spend many network evaluations per sampling step on overlapping windows, multiple re-noising rounds, or backpropagation through the prior. We introduce TesseraFlow, a complex-valued pixel-space flow prior that reduces the first cost. A global encoder reads a low-resolution view of every frame once per sampling step. A single shallow decoder operates on this view during early steps and on full-resolution space-time tiles during later steps, so no network processes a whole frame at full resolution. Our sampler, ReTile, addresses the second reason. We use randomized grid shifting at every sampling step along with re-noising, which acts as a stochastic gradient instead of computing overlapping tiles, so a single network pass per sampling step suffices. On its own, ReTile speeds up an existing global-context patch prior by 6-9x, and our prior adds a further 3-5x speedup. TesseraFlow reconstructs about one 256x256 frame per second, 20-367x faster than patch and latent video priors, and can match or exceed the best generative baseline on cardiac, brain, and abdominal MRI and lung CT, at a fraction of its GPU time.
zh_abstract: 生成式先验在图像重建任务中为医学图像建模达到了最先进水平，但使用视频先验进行重建每帧需要数十秒到数分钟。潜变量先验继承了其自编码器的误差，像素空间整帧先验的内存随帧尺寸增长，而像素空间图像块先验速度慢有两个原因。第一，它们的深度网络在每个采样步骤都以全分辨率处理每一帧，尽管早期步骤只解析低频。第二，它们的采样器在每个采样步骤将大量网络评估花费在重叠窗口、多轮重新加噪或通过先验进行反向传播上。我们提出 TesseraFlow，一种复值像素空间流先验，可降低第一项开销。全局编码器在每个采样步骤读取每一帧的低分辨率视图一次。单个浅层解码器在早期步骤对该视图进行操作，在后期步骤对全分辨率时空瓦片进行操作，因此没有网络以全分辨率处理整帧。我们的采样器 ReTile 解决第二个原因。我们在每个采样步骤使用随机网格偏移并配合重新加噪，其作用类似于随机梯度而非计算重叠瓦片，因此每个采样步骤单次网络传递即可。单独使用时，ReTile 使现有的全局上下文图像块先验加速 6-9 倍，而我们的先验进一步带来 3-5 倍加速。TesseraFlow 每秒重建约一帧 256x256 图像，比图像块和潜变量视频先验快 20-367 倍，并可在心脏、脑和腹部 MRI 以及肺部 CT 上达到或超过最佳生成式基线，且 GPU 时间仅为其一小部分。

title: How AI Advice Influences Physicians' Decisions to Start Blood Pressure Medication
zh_title: 大模型建议如何影响医生启动降压药决策
summary: 北京安贞医院注册观察性研究，计划纳入15–20名医师，评估大模型建议对是否启动降压治疗的影响。
key_points: 观察性设计，计划入组15–20名医师
两轮线上病例判读，比较前后决策
覆盖三个医院层级，尚无结果
reason: 仅方案注册、样本极小且无结果，属增量档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Beijing Anzhen Hospital; conditions: Hypertension; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 20; status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING] This study examines how physicians use advice from a large language model when deciding whether to start blood pressure medication. The study team plans to enroll 15 to 20 licensed physicians who care for adults with hypertension in China, including at least five from each of three hospital levels. Each physician will complete two rounds of online case review in one session lasting about one hour. In the first round, physicians will independently decide whether to start blood pressure medication for 30 cases. They can consult a guideline summary and a cardiovascular risk calculator. In the second round, they will review the same cases in a different order. The platform will show their earlier decision and a previously generated AI recommendation for each case. The main analysis will focus on cases with blood pressure below 130/80 mm Hg and at least one high-risk feature. Among the cases judged correctly in the first round, the study will compare how often decisions change to incorrect medication initiation in cases with incorrect versus correct AI advice. The cases use publicly available, de-identified data from the U.S. National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey. The decisions are recorded for research and have no role in patient care.

abstract: [Current opinion in critical care] Perioperative hemodynamic optimization using goal-directed therapy (GDT) reduces complications and mortality in high-risk surgery. This review synthesizes advances over the last few years, focusing on dynamic physiological targets, predictive artificial intelligence, microcirculatory and endothelial protection, individualized arterial pressure targets, volume stewardship and novel nonadrenergic rescue vasopressors for postcardiopulmonary bypass vasoplegia, and extracorporeal blood purification for refractory vasoplegia in surgical sepsis. Clinical practice has shifted from rigid volumetric protocols toward individualized physiological stewardship and endothelial glycocalyx preservation, framed within the four-phase dynamic continuum (ROSE concept: Resuscitation, Optimization, Stabilization, and Evacuation). Machine-learning algorithms, such as the Hypotension Prediction Index, effectively preempt intraoperative hypotension. Point-of-care ultrasound protocols, notably the venous excess ultrasound (VExUS) score, prevent backward venous congestion. Concurrently, dynamic arterial elastance (Eadyn) distinguishes between vasodilation and preload deficit. In cardiothoracic surgery, postcardiopulmonary bypass vasoplegia mandates cautious fluid restriction and early multimodal nonadrenergic vasopressors, including methylene blue, hydroxocobalamin (vitamin B12), and synthetic angiotensin II, which effectively restore vascular tone and limit catecholamine toxicity. In surgical sepsis and refractory vasoplegic shock, blood purification therapies provide valuable hemodynamic rescue; the pioneer continuous hemodiafiltration with cytokine-adsorbing hemofilters (CAH-CHDF) and recent trial data with polymyxin B hemoperfusion (the TIGRIS trial) demonstrate significant vasopressor-sparing effects and restored vascular tone. Perioperative hemodynamic optimization has evolved into a multimodal, patient-tailored approach. Coupling dynamic fluid responsiveness with predictive monitoring, personalized blood pressure titration, nonadrenergic rescue for postbypass vasoplegic shock, organ venous congestion profiling, and extracorporeal humoral modulation provides comprehensive circulatory support while preventing fluid overload.
zh_abstract: [Current Opinion in Critical Care] 使用目标导向治疗（GDT）进行围手术期血流动力学优化可减少高危手术的并发症和死亡率。本综述综合了过去几年的进展，重点关注动态生理目标、预测性人工智能、微循环与内皮保护、个体化动脉压目标、容量管理，以及用于心肺转流后血管麻痹的新型非肾上腺素能救援性血管升压药和用于外科脓毒症难治性血管麻痹的体外血液净化。临床实践已从僵化的容量方案转向个体化生理管理和内皮糖萼保护，并置于四阶段动态连续体（ROSE概念：复苏Resuscitation、优化Optimization、稳定Stabilization和清除Evacuation）框架内。机器学习算法，如低血压预测指数（Hypotension Prediction Index），可有效预防术中低血压。床旁超声方案，尤其是静脉淤血超声（VExUS）评分，可预防向后的静脉淤血。同时，动态动脉弹性（Eadyn）可区分血管扩张与容量不足。在心胸外科中，心肺转流后血管麻痹要求谨慎限制液体并早期使用多模式非肾上腺素能血管升压药，包括亚甲蓝、羟钴胺（维生素B12）和合成血管紧张素II，这些药物可有效恢复血管张力并限制儿茶酚胺毒性。在外科脓毒症和难治性血管麻痹性休克中，血液净化疗法提供了有价值的血流动力学救援；开创性的细胞因子吸附血液滤器连续性血液透析滤过（CAH-CHDF）以及最近多黏菌素B血液灌流（TIGRIS试验）的试验数据显示出显著的减少血管升压药用量效应和恢复血管张力。围手术期血流动力学优化已演变为多模式、以患者为中心的方法。将动态液体反应性与预测性监测、个体化血压滴定、转流后血管麻痹性休克的非肾上腺素能救援、器官静脉淤血评估以及体外体液调节相结合，可提供全面的循环支持，同时预防液体过负荷。

abstract: Background: Mild cognitive impairment (MCI), frailty, and fall risk often co-occur in older adults and share motor signs, yet they are screened and modeled separately. A unified model that predicts all 3 conditions from 1 sensor-based assessment could support earlier and more efficient screening, but such a model has rarely been developed or rigorously compared with separate models. Objective: This study aimed to develop a unified machine learning model that predicts MCI, frailty, and fall risk together from sensor-based motor-function data, compare it with separate single-label models, explain its predictions, and test its robustness. Methods: Community-dwelling older adults (n=79) completed a multimodal motor-function assessment with the Mizzou Point-of-Care Assessment System (MPASS), covering gait, sit-to-stand, static balance, step-down, and reaction time, with some tasks repeated under a dual-task condition. With demographic and family-history data, this yielded 59 features. Unified classifier-chain and single-label models were built with 5 algorithms across 6 modeling stages, evaluated with repeated nested cross-validation, and compared using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) and paired bootstrap tests. The final model was explained with Shapley additive explanations (SHAP), and its robustness and the sufficiency of the sample size were tested with chain-input, chain-order sensitivity, domain-ablation, learning-curve, and power analyses. Results: With class weighting, the unified model had a higher mean AUC than the single-label models in 17 of 20 configurations and was never significantly worse, and it performed at least as well under nested model selection (0.615 vs 0.605; P=.58). The final extra trees model achieved a mean AUC of 0.645 (95% CI 0.569-0.722); discrimination was best for MCI (AUC 0.779, 95% CI 0.680-0.872) and lower for frailty (0.606) and fall risk (0.551). The model overestimated risk for all 3 outcomes, most for frailty. Most features (43/59, 73%), led by stride length, were shared across the 3 conditions, with consistent SHAP rankings in training and test participants ({rho}=0.99). Predicted frailty was the most important input for fall risk, and the 45 sensor features alone performed as well as the full model. Learning curves suggested that fall-risk prediction would benefit from more participants. Conclusions: A unified model predicted MCI, frailty, and fall risk together from one sensor-based ass
zh_abstract: 【背景】轻度认知障碍（MCI）、衰弱和跌倒风险常在老年人中共存，并共享运动体征，但它们却被分别筛查和建模。一个能够从一次基于传感器的评估中预测全部3种状况的统一模型可支持更早、更高效的筛查，但此类模型很少被开发，也很少与单独模型进行严格比较。【目的】本研究旨在开发一个统一机器学习模型，从基于传感器的运动功能数据中同时预测MCI、衰弱和跌倒风险，将其与单独的单标签模型进行比较，解释其预测并检验其稳健性。【方法】社区居住的老年人（n=79）使用Mizzou Point-of-Care Assessment System（MPASS）完成多模态运动功能评估，涵盖步态、坐立、静态平衡、下台阶和反应时间，其中一些任务在双任务条件下重复。结合人口学和家族史数据，共产生59个特征。使用5种算法在6个建模阶段构建统一分类器链和单标签模型，采用重复嵌套交叉验证进行评估，并使用受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）和配对bootstrap检验进行比较。最终模型用沙普利加性解释（SHAP）进行解释，并通过链输入、链顺序敏感性、领域消融、学习曲线和功效分析检验其稳健性及样本量是否充足。【结果】在类别加权下，统一模型在20种配置中的17种中平均AUC高于单标签模型，且从未显著更差，并且在嵌套模型选择下表现至少同样好（0.615 vs 0.605；P=.58）。最终极端随机树模型的平均AUC为0.645（95% CI 0.569-0.722）；MCI的区分度最佳（AUC 0.779，95% CI 0.680-0.872），衰弱（0.606）和跌倒风险（0.551）较低。该模型高估了全部3种结局的风险，其中对衰弱的高估最明显。大多数特征（43/59，73%）为3种状况共享，其中以步幅为首，训练和测试参与者中的SHAP排序一致（{rho}=0.99）。预测的衰弱是跌倒风险最重要的输入，仅45个传感器特征的表现与完整模型一样好。学习曲线提示跌倒风险预测会受益于更多参与者。【结论】一个统一模型从一次基于传感器的评估中同时预测了MCI、衰弱和跌倒风险

abstract: Diabetes leads to several health complications throughout the body, with the complication in the eyes being Diabetic Retinopathy. It leads to damaging or abnormal changes in the blood vessels' structure, causing vision loss. The need for massive screening of a large population of diabetic patients has created a necessity for computer-aided, fully automatic diagnosis of DR. CNNs have shown great promise in the classification of DR based on the Fundus images. Building a reliable model faces considerable challenges due to the limited availability of high-quality annotated datasets and issues with varying image quality and class imbalances. This paper aims to demonstrate the UNET, and its Stacked Architecture variant and their performance across several datasets. This paper has compared and studied the UNET architecture's performance across multiple stacks and has come to a soft conclusion that the architecture performs its best at three stacks, and any more leads to deterioration of its performance. The model aims at classifying the images into five categories, 0 to 4, where 0 is no DR, and 4 is proliferative DR.
zh_abstract: 糖尿病会在全身导致多种健康并发症，其中眼部并发症为糖尿病视网膜病变（Diabetic Retinopathy，DR）。它会导致血管结构发生损伤性或异常改变，造成视力丧失。对大量糖尿病患者进行大规模筛查的需求，促使人们需要计算机辅助的、全自动的DR诊断。CNN在基于眼底图像进行DR分类方面已显示出巨大前景。由于高质量标注数据集有限，以及图像质量变化和类别不平衡等问题，构建可靠模型面临相当大的挑战。本文旨在展示UNET及其堆叠架构变体，并展示它们在多个数据集上的性能。本文比较并研究了UNET架构在多个堆叠下的性能，并得出一个温和结论：该架构在三个堆叠时表现最佳，任何更多堆叠都会导致其性能下降。该模型旨在将图像分为五类，0至4，其中0为无DR，4为增殖性DR。

abstract: This study explores the application of various deep learning models for the segmentation of lung nodules using LIDC-IDRI. Unlike traditional approaches that utilize the full dataset, our work emphasizes the efficacy of training models on a filtered subset of 356 samples. Novel configurations, including attention mechanisms and advanced preprocessing strategies, were employed to optimize segmentation accuracy. Among the models evaluated, the DPL nkNet50 with a Channel Attention Bridge and ResNet backbone demonstrated the highest performance with a Dice score of 0.86, significantly outperforming conventional architectures. This work underscores the potential of leveraging data efficiency and tailored architectures in achieving robust segmentation performance, paving the way for improved computer-aided diagnosis in clinical settings.
zh_abstract: 本研究探讨了多种深度学习模型在LIDC-IDRI数据集上用于肺结节分割的应用。与使用完整数据集的传统方法不同，我们的工作强调在经筛选的356个样本子集上训练模型的有效性。研究采用了包括注意力机制和先进预处理策略在内的新配置，以优化分割准确性。在评估的模型中，带有Channel Attention Bridge（通道注意力桥）和ResNet主干的DPL nkNet50表现最佳，Dice分数为0.86，显著优于传统架构。本工作凸显了利用数据效率和定制化架构实现稳健分割性能的潜力，为临床环境中改进计算机辅助诊断铺平了道路。
